### [88] [Head-Pose-Aware Visual Speech Recognition with FiLM Modulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00751)
*Matthew Kit Khinn Teng,Haibo Zhang,Takeshi Saitoh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出HP-VSR-ResFiLM框架，通过显式引入头部姿态信息（pose-conditioned residual FiLM模块）提升视觉语音识别在非正面视角下的鲁棒性，在LRS2和LRS3上分别取得25.0%和33.2%的WER。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VSR方法受限于视素歧义和姿态变化（几何畸变、遮挡），缺乏显式处理头部姿态信息的机制，导致非正面视角下视觉表征鲁棒性不足。

Method: 两阶段流水线：阶段1为姿态条件视觉编码器（2D CNN前端 + 姿态条件残差FiLM块），显式利用头部姿态自适应调整视觉特征；阶段2使用预训练NLLB语言模型进行音素到文本重建。

Result: 在LRS2和LRS3上WER分别为25.0%和33.2%，无需额外训练数据。消融实验表明单个残差FiLM块即可提升整体WER，在Layer 3/4深度调制对大偏航角（>30°）样本增益显著。

Conclusion: 显式的姿态感知特征调制为无约束场景下VSR鲁棒性提升提供了有效且计算高效的方案。

Abstract: Visual Speech Recognition (VSR) aims to recognize speech from visual cues such as lip movements, but its performance is fundamentally limited by viseme ambiguity and pose-induced variations that introduce geometric distortions and occlusions. Existing approaches mainly rely on linguistic context or implicit invariance, leaving visual representations insufficiently robust under non-frontal views. In this work, we propose a pose-aware phoneme-level framework, termed HP-VSR-ResFiLM, that explicitly incorporates head-pose information into visual feature extraction. The proposed framework adopts a two-stage pipeline consisting of a pose-conditioned visual encoder in Stage 1 and a pretrained NLLB language model in Stage 2 for phoneme-to-text reconstruction. Specifically, Stage 1 incorporates a pose-conditioned residual Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) block after the 2D CNN frontend to adaptively refine visual representations using head-pose information. Experiments on LRS2 and LRS3 demonstrate that HP-VSR-ResFiLM achieves competitive performance under comparable training conditions, attaining word error rates (WER) of 25.0% and 33.2%, respectively, without relying on additional training data. Ablation studies further show that a single residual FiLM block consistently improves overall WER, while deeper modulation at Layers 3 and 4 provides larger gains for samples with yaw angles greater than 30° without degrading performance for smaller pose variations. These findings demonstrate that explicit pose-aware feature modulation offers an effective and computationally efficient solution for improving VSR robustness in unconstrained settings.

</details>


### [89] [GIRL-DETR: Gradient-Isolated Reinforcement Learning for Video Moment Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00775)
*Shihang Zhang,Mingjin Kuai,Ye Wei,Zhen Zhang,Wei Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对视频时刻检索中连续代理损失与非可微指标间的错位问题，提出GIRL-DETR，首次将强化学习后训练引入轻量级时序定位框架，通过冻结骨干网络+三阶段渐进式RL策略解耦状态表示与指标优化，在三个数据集上显著提升精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VMR模型在训练后期因连续代理损失与非可微评价指标(tIoU)不匹配导致优化停滞、边界预测陷入次优解。虽然RL后训练对大型模型有效，但直接应用于轻量级网络会破坏监督阶段建立的脆弱特征表示。

Method: 1) 跨模态交互(CMI)实现视频与文本的早期对齐；2) 文本引导门控(TGG)动态注入语义先验到查询中；3) 三阶段渐进式强化学习(TPRL)：冻结骨干网络保护特征流形，检测头直接优化tIoU指标。

Result: 在Charades-STA、QVHighlights和TACoS三个基准上，GIRL-DETR有效解决了代理损失退化问题，仅通过少量参数更新即可实现显著的精度提升。

Conclusion: GIRL-DETR通过正交解耦状态表示与指标优化，首次将RL后训练成功应用于轻量级VMR模型，为RL在轻量级时序定位中的应用提供了稳健的新路径。

Abstract: Video Moment Retrieval (VMR) task requires accurately localizing temporal boundaries aligned with natural language queries, but many models suffer from a misalignment between continuous surrogate losses and non-differentiable metrics, leading to optimization stagnation during the late stages of training and trapping boundary predictions in suboptimal solutions. Although Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training successfully optimizes localization results for large models, applying it directly to lightweight networks easily disrupts the fragile feature representations established during the supervised phase. To overcome this optimization bottleneck, we propose Gradient-Isolated Reinforcement Learning for DETR (GIRL-DETR), introducing RL post-training into a lightweight temporal localization framework for the first time. The input video and text features first establish early alignment through Cross-Modal Interaction (CMI) before entering the transformer encoder. Subsequently, a Text-Guided Gating (TGG) mechanism dynamically injects semantic priors into the queries before the transformer decoder generates candidate proposals, providing high signal-to-noise ratio inputs for temporal prediction. After the supervised training reaches convergence, the backbone network is frozen to protect the feature manifold, while the detection head directly optimizes the non-differentiable evaluation metric tIoU to enhance localization accuracy through a Three-stage Progressive Reinforcement Learning (TPRL) strategy. This approach achieves an orthogonal decoupling of state representation and metric optimization. Experiments on Charades-STA, QVHighlights, and TACoS demonstrate that GIRL-DETR effectively resolves surrogate loss degradation and achieves substantial accuracy improvements with minimal parameter updates, providing a robust new pathway for RL applications in lightweight VMR models.

</details>


### [90] [FlowOVD: Learning Generative Latent Flows for Zero-shot Open-vocabulary Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00782)
*Yao Wei,Andrea Cavallaro,Changjae Oh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FlowOVD，一种基于整流流（rectified flow）的文本条件查询生成框架，将开放词汇目标检测（OVD）中的解码器查询生成建模为连续传输过程，在无需额外训练数据的情况下，在COCO和LVIS上分别达到49.5 AP和31.5 AP，显著超越GroundingDINO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OVD方法通常将其建模为判别式预测问题，解码器查询要么是静态的，要么从编码器特征初始化，限制了多样性和灵活性。本文引入生成式视角，将查询生成视为潜在空间中的连续传输过程。

Method: 提出FlowOVD框架，基于整流流（rectified flow）将文本无关的查询逐步变换为文本引导的查询，在视觉-语言模型（VLM）检测器中引入连续的潜在查询动态，避免启发式离散查询构建。

Result: 无需额外训练数据，FlowOVD在COCO上达到49.5 AP，在LVIS上达到31.5 AP，分别超越GroundingDINO +1.2 AP（+2.5%）和+4.1 AP（+15.0%）。

Conclusion: 连续查询生成在开放词汇泛化中效果显著，尤其在长尾分布的LVIS基准上提升更大，验证了该方法在处理稀有类别时的有效性。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) has achieved remarkable progress through large-scale vision-language pre-training. Existing methods, however, typically formulate OVD as a discriminative prediction problem, where decoder queries are either static or initialized from encoder features, thus limiting their diversity and flexibility. In this paper, we introduce a generative perspective by modeling decoder query generation as a continuous transport process in latent space. We propose FlowOVD, a text-conditioned query generation framework based on rectified flow that progressively transforms text-agnostic queries into text-guided queries. By introducing continuous latent query dynamics into a vision-language model (VLM) based detector, our method avoids heuristic discrete query construction and enables more expressive semantic alignment for open-vocabulary detection. Without requiring additional training data, FlowOVD achieves 49.5 AP on COCO and 31.5 AP on LVIS, outperforming GroundingDINO by +1.2 AP (+2.5 %) and +4.1 AP (+15.0 %), respectively. The larger gain on the challenging long-tailed LVIS benchmark further highlights the effectiveness of continuous query generation for open-vocabulary generalization.

</details>


### [91] [DINO-GFSA: Geo-Localization via Semantic Gated Fusion and Mamba-based Sequential Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00784)
*Beier Hu,Yuanshen Guo,Jialu Cai,Chengwei Li,Yong Wang,Shunan Wu,Zhigang Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DINO-GFSA框架，结合LoRA微调的DINOv3骨干、语义门控残差融合模块和Mamba时序聚合头，在无人机跨视角地理定位任务上达到SOTA，DenseUAV数据集Recall@1提升3.48%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机在GNSS拒止环境下的跨视角地理定位中，如何在保留细粒度空间细节的同时获取鲁棒语义特征是一个关键挑战。

Method: (1) 采用LoRA微调的DINOv3 (ViT-L)作为骨干网络实现参数高效表示；(2) 提出语义门控残差融合模块，利用高层语义选择性校准和整合低层空间线索；(3) 设计基于Mamba的时序聚合头，以线性复杂度捕获长距离空间依赖。

Result: 在University-1652和DenseUAV基准上达到SOTA，DenseUAV数据集上Recall@1超过此前最佳方法3.48%。

Conclusion: DINO-GFSA被验证为一种通用且鲁棒的无人机跨视角地理定位解决方案。

Abstract: Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) is critical for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) self-positioning and target localization in GNSS-denied environments. However, acquiring robust semantics while preserving finegrained spatial details remains challenging. To address this, we propose DINO-GFSA, a framework leveraging a LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adapted DINOv3 (ViTL) backbone for parameter-efficient, high-capacity representation. Crucially, we introduce a Semantic Gated Residual Fusion module, which utilizes high-level semantics to selectively calibrate and integrate low-level spatial cues, effectively bridging the semantic gap. Furthermore, a Mamba-based Sequential Aggregation Head is designed to capture long-range spatial dependencies with linear complexity. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on University-1652 and DenseUAV benchmarks, notably surpassing the previous best on DenseUAV by 3.48% on Recall@1. These results validate DINO-GFSA as a generalized, robust solution for UAV CVGL.

</details>


### [92] [MBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark on Memory Capability for Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00793)
*Shengjun Zhang,Zhang Zhang,Simin Huang,Zhenyu Tang,Hanyang Wang,Chensheng Dai,Min Chen,Yifan Li,Yuxin Li,Yingjie Chen,Hao Liu,Chen Li,Yueqi Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了MBench基准，用于评估视频世界模型的记忆能力，从实体一致性、环境一致性和因果一致性三个维度进行量化分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成基准主要关注视觉质量、运动连贯性和文本-视频对齐，忽视了世界模型的核心能力——长期记忆和状态一致性维持。

Method: 将记忆能力分解为实体一致性、环境一致性、因果一致性三个层次，细分为12个可量化子维度；基于真实长视频构建，采用规则定量矩阵和VLM进行综合评估。

Result: 对主流视频世界模型的评估揭示了现有方法在长期状态保持方面存在系统性缺陷。

Conclusion: MBench为视频世界模型的记忆能力提供了标准化评估基准，为后续研究指明了方向。

Abstract: Recent advancements in video-based world models have demonstrated an unprecedented ability to synthesize high-fidelity visual sequences. However, a fundamental gap persists between visually plausible video generation and the functional requirements of a world model, particularly in maintaining a stable and reasonable internal state over extended temporal horizons. While existing benchmarks primarily emphasize visual quality, motion coherence, and text-video alignment, they largely overlook memory, the core capability of a world model to preserve consistency across long-term horizons and complex interactions. To address this gap, we present \textbf{MBench}, a comprehensive benchmark dedicated to quantifying and evaluating the memory capability of video world models. We systematically decompose the memory capability of video world models into three hierarchical and complementary core dimensions: entity consistency, environment consistency, and causal consistency, which are further refined into 12 quantifiable sub-dimensions for comprehensive characterization of long-term memory. Our benchmark is built upon rigorously curated real-captured long videos, and evaluated by rule-based quantitative matrices and VLM to enable objective and comprehensive consistency assessment. Extensive evaluations of mainstream state-of-the-art video world models reveal critical systemic limitations of existing methods in long-term state retention, providing a standardized benchmark and clear research direction to advance the field.

</details>


### [93] [DASH: Dual-Branch Score Distillation for Guidance-Calibrated Compact Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00798)
*Abdullah Al Shafi,Kazi Saeed Alam,Sk Imran Hossain,Engelbert Mephu Nguifo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对条件扩散模型在输出级蒸馏中无条件分数分支无监督、导致引导失效的问题，提出DASH双分支蒸馏框架，独立监督两个分数分支，并引入TIRT迁移教师课程先验，在5.9倍压缩下保持接近教师质量的生成效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有条件扩散模型的参数压缩存在未被充分探索的局限：输出级蒸馏中无条件分数分支未被监督，导致学生模型中无分类器引导的间隙不确定，引导效果可能完全失效。

Method: 提出DASH框架：(1) 双分支蒸馏，独立监督条件与无条件分数分支；(2) 锚定正则项，将条件预测约束至真实噪声；(3) TIRT迁移，将教师收敛的逐时间步重要性课程作为冻结先验复制给学生。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上，5.9倍压缩下50步DDIM采样的FID与教师差距在4以内，显著优于从头训练；无条件监督贡献超过60%的蒸馏增益。

Conclusion: 双分支约束是保持引导保真度的关键，消融实验验证了无条件监督、课程迁移和锚定正则化的互补有效性。

Abstract: Parameter compression of class-conditional diffusion models reveals an underexplored limitation in output-level distillation: the unconditional score branch remains unsupervised, leaving the classifier-free guidance gap underdetermined in the student. This gap, amplified at every denoising step, admits degenerate solutions where both branches collapse toward identical predictions, rendering guidance ineffective despite low output-level training loss. This paper introduces DASH, a dual-branch distillation framework that independently supervises both score branches, uniquely specifying target branch outputs for each training sample through independent branch constraints, with an anchor term regularising conditional predictions toward ground-truth noise. The framework further introduces TIRT Transfer, which copies the teacher's converged per-timestep importance curriculum into the student as a frozen prior, eliminating the need to relearn it within limited distillation budgets. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 demonstrate that 5.9x compression maintains quality within 4 FID points of the teacher at 50-step DDIM sampling, considerably outperforming training from scratch with guidance fidelity well preserved. Ablation studies confirm that unconditional supervision is the dominant contribution, accounting for over 60% of total distillation gain. Curriculum transfer and anchor regularisation provide complementary benefit, together validating dual-branch constraints as empirically essential for guidance-preserving compression.

</details>


### [94] [SuperMemory-VQA: An Egocentric Visual Question-Answering Benchmark for Long-Horizon Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00825)
*Samiul Alam,Shakhrul Iman Siam,Michael J. Proulx,James Fort,Richard Newcombe,Hyo Jin Kim,Mi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了SuperMemory-VQA数据集，包含52.9小时日常活动的AI眼镜第一视角视频及4853个问答对，用于评估AI助手在长期记忆任务上的表现。现有模型在该数据集上表现不佳，表明需要新的架构来实现可靠的情境记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有第一视角数据集主要关注短片段的行为识别或通用问答，衡量的是感知能力而非真实的人类记忆需求。为了让AI眼镜真正成为个性化记忆助手，需要超越短期视频理解，解决人类在长期第一视角视频流中的记忆缺口问题。

Method: 收集52.9小时AI眼镜日常活动数据（含RGB视频、音频转录、眼动追踪、IMU、SLAM轨迹），通过人工验证标注流程构建4853个多项选择问答对，涵盖物体/位置记忆、意图回忆、场景回忆、时间线重建、对话记忆和上下文检索等任务，并设置"不可回答"选项以测试幻觉鲁棒性。

Result: 对主流智能体框架和大语言模型骨干的基准测试表明，现有系统在真实世界记忆任务上远未达到可靠水平。

Conclusion: 需要开发新的架构来实现可靠的情境AI记忆，使系统仅在证据充分时才能回答，参与者调查也证实了问题的真实性、实用性和与日常记忆需求的一致性。

Abstract: AI glasses present a compelling platform for AI agents to serve as personalized memory assistants. To be genuinely useful, such systems must move beyond short-term video comprehension and address memory gaps that humans experience for practical, personal, or social purposes over longitudinal egocentric video streams. However, existing egocentric datasets predominantly focus on action recognition or generic QAs from short clips, measuring perceptual capabilities rather than realistic human memory needs. We introduce SuperMemory-VQA, an egocentric visual question answering (VQA) dataset for evaluating AI assistants on practical, long-horizon memory tasks. It contains 52.9 hours of everyday activities recorded with AI glasses, including synchronized RGB video, audio transcription, eye gaze, IMU, and SLAM trajectories. Through a human-verified annotation pipeline, we construct grounded 4,853 question-answer pairs that span object and location memory, intent recall, visual scene recall, timeline reconstruction, conversational memory, and in-context retrieval. Each question is posed as multiple-choice with an explicit "unanswerable" option to test hallucination robustness. Benchmarking leading agentic frameworks and LLM backbones reveals that existing systems remain far from reliable on real-world memory tasks, highlighting the need for new architectures for grounded AI memory that can answer only when evidence is sufficient. A participant survey further supports that our questions are realistic, useful, and aligned with everyday memory needs.

</details>


### [95] [RoboStressBench: Benchmarking VLM Robustness to Physical Visual Stress in Embodied Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00828)
*Leyi Wu,Yifan Zhao,Jinjie Zhang,Suzeyu Chen,Wosong Chen,Zhifei Chen,Tianshuo Xu,Qingchun He,Hongxin Hu,Haojian Huang,Yangkai Wei,Wenqian Li,Yinchuan Li,Ying-Cong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RoboStressBench基准，从逆图形学角度将视觉压力分解为材质、视角、光照、几何四个物理维度，系统评估VLM在真实物理场景中的鲁棒性，并引入压力感知智能体来提升高压力场景下的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准仅用干净图像或孤立扰动评估VLM，忽略了真实场景中物理因素导致的视觉压力，且覆盖范围有限。

Method: 基于逆图形学视角和物理渲染方程，将视觉压力分解为材质(M)、视角(V)、光照(L)、几何(G)四个物理维度，构建RoboStressBench基准；并提出压力感知智能体求解器，检测压力源并调用视觉编辑技能后再进行推理。

Result: 识别出不同物理因素会退化不同的具身能力（识别、推理、规划），发现压力相关的特定失败模式，这些模式在聚合准确率中常被掩盖。

Conclusion: RoboStressBench为诊断和提升VLM在真实物理压力下的感知能力提供了原则性评估框架，有助于开发更可靠的具身AI系统。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong visual understanding and are increasingly deployed in embodied AI systems, where reliable perception under real conditions is essential. However, existing benchmarks assess VLMs using clean images or isolated perturbations rather than stresses caused by physical scene formation. This design has two limitations: it covers only a narrow subset of everyday visual stresses, and some perturbations rarely appear in realistic embodied scenes. This gap raises a fundamental question: how can we define visual stress in a principled way that captures the diverse factors encountered in physical environments? To address this question, we formulate visual perception from an inverse graphics perspective and introduce RoboStressBench, a benchmark for evaluating VLM robustness to physical visual stress in embodied scenes. Inspired by the physical rendering equation, RoboStressBench decomposes visual stress into four physically grounded dimensions: Material (M), Viewpoint (V), Lighting (L), and Geometry (G). This design enables RoboStressBench to cover a broad range of visual stresses in real-world environments, while allowing controlled analysis of their effects on VLM capabilities such as visual recognition, reasoning, and planning. Through comprehensive evaluations of state-of-the-art VLMs, we identify stress-specific failure modes and reveal that different physical factors degrade different embodied capabilities, which are often obscured by aggregate accuracy. We further introduce a stress-aware agentic solver that detects visual stressors and invokes visual-editing skills before reasoning, improving robustness in high-stress scenarios. Overall, RoboStressBench provides a principled evaluation framework for diagnosing and improving VLM perception under real-world physical stress, supporting the development of more reliable embodied AI systems.

</details>


### [96] [The Right Inference Strategy Is All You Need: Nearly Training-Free Domain-Wise Inference for EgoCross Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00829)
*Leyi Wu,Yifan Zhao,Jinjie Zhang,Yinchuan Li,Ying-Cong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoCross提出了一种几乎无需训练的领域感知推理策略，通过针对手术、工业组装、极限运动和动物视角四个目标域分别设计输入、提示和答案映射方式，使冻结的Qwen3-VL-4B模型在仅有20个训练样本的源受限设定下达到66.98%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在日常生活场景外的极端领域（手术、工业组装、极限运动、动物视角）表现不佳，且存在源受限（仅20个训练样本）的挑战。作者观察到冻结的基线模型并非完全无法处理这些罕见场景，而是缺乏合适的接口来迁移已有的视觉-语言知识。

Method: 采用领域感知推理策略：1) 将四个目标域分开处理；2) 针对每个域的因果关系设计不同的输入、提示和答案映射流程；3) 手术和动物视角直接使用冻结的Qwen3-VL-4B模型，极限运动和工业组装仅使用在20个训练样本上训练2个epoch的官方SFT检查点。

Result: 在最终评测中达到66.98%的整体准确率，表明精心设计的领域感知推理可以弥补模型本身能力有限的问题，并恢复基线模型中已有的能力。

Conclusion: 该工作证明在源极度受限的设定下，解决方向不在于模型规模扩展，而在于如何向受限模型暴露正确的视觉、时序和答案选择线索。领域感知的推理策略可以在几乎无需训练的情况下显著提升多模态大模型在极端域适应场景下的表现。

Abstract: EgoCross evaluates multimodal large language models on egocentric video question answering under substantial domain shift, where test videos come from surgery, industrial assembly, extreme sports, and animal-mounted cameras rather than ordinary daily-life scenes. In the source-limited track, the base model is fixed to Qwen3-VL-4B, while the official task-specific support set contains only 20 training samples. This setting makes the challenge less about model scaling and more about exposing the right visual, temporal, and answer-selection cues to a constrained model. Our key observation is that the frozen baseline model is not simply incapable of these rare scenarios; rather, it often fails to transfer its existing visual-language knowledge to the new task format without an appropriate interface. We therefore use a domain-wise inference strategy that treats the four target domains separately and designs different input, prompting, and answer-mapping procedures according to each domain's task characteristics. These strategies make the rare egocentric scenes more interpretable to the VLM by emphasizing the cues that matter for each domain. The resulting system is nearly training-free: surgery, and animal questions are answered with the base Qwen3-VL-4B model, while XSports and industry use only the official SFT checkpoint trained for two epochs on the provided 20 training samples. On the final evaluation, this simple strategy reaches 66.98\% overall accuracy, suggesting that careful domain-aware inference can compensate for limited base-model strength and recover much of the ability already present in the baseline model.

</details>


### [97] [MoEIoU: Rethinking Bounding-Box Regression as a Mixture of Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00844)
*Vinay Edula,Priyanka Bagade*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MoEIoU，一种基于混合专家系统的边界框回归损失函数，通过log-sum-exp聚合重叠、中心对齐和宽高比失配三项，并采用课程学习式权重调度，在多个数据集和YOLO架构上优于现有IoU损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于IoU的损失函数在训练过程中使用固定的几何惩罚项，未能考虑优化动态——初始阶段预测框存在较大的中心距离和形状误差，后期则应专注于提升重叠度。这种固定的惩罚策略无法自适应调整优化重点。

Method: 提出MoEIoU损失：1) 联合建模重叠度、中心对齐和宽高比失配三个组件；2) 使用log-sum-exp函数聚合各组件，强调主导误差项同时保持其他项的平滑贡献；3) 设计课程式权重调度，早期优先修正位置和形状，后期优先提升重叠度。

Result: 在PASCAL VOC、HRIPCB和MS COCO数据集上，使用多种YOLO架构进行实验，并辅以大规模仿真实验。MoEIoU一致优于标准及最先进的损失函数，展现出更快的收敛速度和更高的定位精度。

Conclusion: MoEIoU的自适应聚合机制可有效改进现有IoU损失函数，为边界框回归提供更优的优化引导，在目标检测框架中具有广泛适用性。

Abstract: Bounding-box regression is a fundamental component of object detection, playing a critical role in precise object localization. Existing Intersection-over-Union (IoU)-based loss functions extend the IoU objective by incorporating geometric penalties, such as center-distance and aspect-ratio mismatch, to improve bounding-box regression. However, these penalties typically remain fixed throughout training and do not account for the optimization dynamics in which predicted boxes initially exhibit large center-distance and shape errors, with later stages focusing on improving overlap with the ground truth. To address this limitation, we introduce MoEIoU, a mixture-of-experts based regression loss that jointly models overlap, center alignment, and aspect-ratio mismatch. MoEIoU aggregates these components using a log-sum-exp function, which emphasizes the dominant localization error while maintaining smooth contributions from other terms. Additionally, a curriculum-based weighting schedule is employed to prioritize correcting box position and shape in early training stages and improving overlap in later stages. We evaluated proposed MoEIoU on PASCAL VOC, HRIPCB, and MS COCO using multiple YOLO architectures, along with large-scale simulation experiments. It consistently outperforms standard and recent state-of-the-art losses, demonstrating faster convergence and improved localization accuracy. We further show that this adaptive aggregation improves existing IoU-based losses, yielding consistent gains and providing more effective optimization guidance for bounding-box regression in object detection frameworks.

</details>


### [98] [RefDiffNet: Learning to Expose Subtle PCB Defects Before Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00852)
*Vinay Edula,Nilesh Badwe,Priyanka Bagade*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RefDiffNet是一个轻量级即插即用的输入增强模块，通过引入无缺陷参考图像来突出缺陷区域，显著提升PCB缺陷检测性能（最高18% mAP50:95提升），且仅增加极少的参数量和计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习的PCB缺陷检测方法仅依赖被检测PCB图像，忽略了无缺陷参考图像中蕴含的布局信息，导致小缺陷难以从复杂背景中区分。

Method: 提出RefDiffNet，一种轻量级即插即用的输入增强模块，置于检测器骨干网络前。它将缺陷图像与对齐后的无缺陷参考图像进行比对，捕捉相对于参考图像的结构变化，使用轻量级编码器输出缺陷区域被高亮的原始图像，从而降低下游检测器的难度。

Result: 在HRIPCB和DeepPCB数据集上，RefDiffNet一致提升了YOLOv8至YOLOv26、RT-DETR、Faster R-CNN等不同检测器的性能，最高实现18%的mAP50:95相对提升，仅引入0.004-0.005M额外参数和0.7-0.8 GFLOPs，不超过任何评估检测器参数量的0.25%。

Conclusion: RefDiffNet作为一种轻量级、即插即用、检测器无关的输入增强模块，能够以极小的计算代价显著提升PCB缺陷检测性能，将经典检测中利用参考图像的思想成功引入深度学习时代。

Abstract: Printed circuit board (PCB) defect detection is challenging because many defects are small and difficult to distinguish from complex background patterns. Most deep learning-based PCB inspection methods rely only on the inspected PCB image for defect detection, ignoring the defect-free reference image that encodes the expected layout of traces, pads, and other PCB structures. In this work, we propose RefDiffNet, a lightweight plug-and-play input enhancement block placed before the detector backbone to enhance the image before defect detection. RefDiffNet brings one proven idea from classical inspection into the deep learning era, using a defect-free reference image to reveal defects. RefDiffNet compares the defective image with the aligned reference, captures structural changes relative to the reference, and uses a lightweight encoder to output the original image with defective regions highlighted, thereby making the downstream detector's task easier. Results on HRIPCB and DeepPCB show that RefDiffNet consistently improves performance across detector families, including one-stage detectors from YOLOv8 to YOLOv26, the transformer-based RT-DETR, and the two-stage Faster R-CNN. It achieves up to 18% relative mAP50:95 gain with negligible overhead, introducing only 0.004 - 0.005M additional parameters and 0.7 - 0.8 GFLOPs, amounting to at most 0.25% of the parameter count of any evaluated detector. Results establish RefDiffNet as a lightweight, plug-and-play, detector-agnostic input enhancement module that substantially improves PCB defect detection with minimal computational cost.

</details>


### [99] [Benchmarks for Vision-Language Models in Urban Perception Should Be Reliability-Aware and Negotiated](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00871)
*Rashid Mushkani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文论证了在评估VLM用于城市感知任务时，应将标注者的分歧和弃权视为测量结果，而非噪声；基于蒙特利尔100个街景的30维度标注实验，发现模型与人类共识的一致性随人类可靠性变化，且在"整体印象"维度存在分布性偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的VLM评估框架忽略了城市感知任务中人类判断存在分歧和弃权的固有特性，简单地将标注一致性作为唯一指标，未能反映真实应用场景中的不确定性和测量复杂性。

Method: 收集100个蒙特利尔街景在30个维度上的12位参与者（来自7个社区组织）的标注数据，对7个VLM进行确定性零样本评估，通过比较人类间可靠性与模型-人类一致性来分析分歧和弃权模式。

Result: 模型与人类共识的一致性随维度层面的人类可靠性共变；在"整体印象"维度，模型与标注者存在分布性不匹配，包括"不适用"回答比例的差异。

Conclusion: 基准创建者、模型开发者和机构应将不确定性和基准假设在评估报告中明确呈现，将标签空间和评分策略视为可协商的人造物。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to generate structured descriptions of street-level imagery for tasks such as streetscape auditing, mapping, and public consultation. These uses combine observable attributes with appraisal categories, and the human targets are often distributions of judgments with disagreement and explicit non-response. This paper argues that benchmarking VLMs for urban perception should treat disagreement and abstention as measurement outcomes, report inter-annotator reliability alongside model alignment, and treat the label space and scoring policy as negotiable artifacts when outputs are intended to inform urban governance. We ground the argument in a benchmark of 100 Montreal street scenes annotated along 30 dimensions by 12 participants from seven community organizations, and in a deterministic zero-shot evaluation of seven VLMs. Across dimensions, model agreement with human consensus co-varies with dimension-level human reliability, and for the appraisal dimension Overall Impression models and annotators exhibit distributional mismatch including different rates of Not applicable. We close with actions for benchmark creators, model developers, and institutions to make uncertainty and benchmark assumptions visible in evaluation reports.

</details>


### [100] [Images as Tables: In-Context Learning with TabPFN for Low-Data Detection of AI-Generated Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00872)
*Jan Philip Walter,Shashank Agnihotri,Margret Keuper*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于DINOv3特征提取+PCA降维+TabPFN表格推理的AI生成图像检测方法，在低数据场景下性能优于现有SOTA方法LATTE，优势达8.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI生成图像检测是一个不断变化的目标问题：针对某一生成器训练的检测器在新生成器出现时往往失效，且仅有少量标注样本可用。

Method: 将图像转化为表格形式：用冻结的DINOv3骨干编码图像，用PCA将CLS特征降维为500维结构化行，再用TabPFN通过上下文表格推理进行真/假分类，无需特定任务分类器训练。

Result: 在大量标注样本场景下，LATTE仍领先7.4%；但在低数据场景下，本方法优于LATTE达8.2%；在跨生成器的迁移场景中也表现更强。

Conclusion: 表格基础模型可作为图像取证的强互补适应机制，将检测器适应从重新训练转变为轻量化的上下文更新。

Abstract: AI-generated image detection is a moving-target problem: detectors trained on one generator often fail when a new generator appears, and only a few labeled examples are available. We study a simple image-to-table formulation for this regime, where each image is encoded by a frozen DINOv3 backbone, its CLS feature is reduced to a 500-dimensional structured row with PCA, and TabPFN performs real/fake classification by in-context tabular inference rather than task-specific classifier training. This turns fake-image detection into low-data structured prediction over learned visual features, making detector adaptation depend on the labeled context set instead of gradient-based fine-tuning. On GenImage, LATTE, a recent state-of-the-art detector, remains stronger when many labeled samples from all generators are available, by 7.4% in the largest pooled setting, but DINOv3-PCA-TabPFN is stronger in the practically important low-data regime, outperforming LATTE by up to 8.2%, and in transfer settings where the detector must generalize from one generator to another. These results position tabular foundation models as a strong complementary adaptation mechanism for image forensics, shifting adaptation from detector retraining to lightweight in-context updates with a small labeled set of examples. Code URL: https://github.com/jpwalter30/Towards-Generalizable-Detection-of-AI-Generated-Images

</details>


### [101] [GABI: Geometry-Aware Boundary Integration for Spacecraft Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00886)
*Iason Georgios Velentzas,Dhruv Ahuja,Panagiotis Tsiotras*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GABI——一种轻量级边界感知多任务分割架构，通过辅助距离场预测头提升航天器在太空恶劣光照条件下的分割精度，在保持低模型复杂度的同时超越重级Transformer模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 太空恶劣光照条件导致图像外观高度多变，现有分割方法在不同航天器和环境间泛化能力差，而准确分割对自主航天器的3D态势感知至关重要。

Method: 在卷积骨干网络上增加一个辅助距离场预测头，形成多任务分割架构。距离场在目标边界周围提供密集的几何监督，促使网络学习空间一致的航天器结构表征，同时保持低模型复杂度。

Result: 在SPARK基准上，距离场监督使基线模型平均精度提升高达5%；泛化实验中平均精度提升超50%；轻量版GABI在IoU和F1-score上与重Transformer模型差距在5%以内，参数量小约10倍；重型GABI超越Transformer，轻约3倍。

Conclusion: GABI验证了距离场监督作为轻量级多任务辅助任务的有效性，能够在保持低模型复杂度前提下显著提升空间目标分割的泛化能力和精度，适合星载感知系统。

Abstract: Accurate segmentation is crucial for autonomous spacecraft, as it directly affects downstream tasks related to 3D situational awareness. The harsh illumination conditions of space, however, produce images with high variability in appearance, hindering the generalization of segmentation approaches across different spacecraft and environments. In this work, we propose GABI, a lightweight boundary-aware multi-task segmentation architecture that augments a convolutional backbone with an auxiliary distance-field prediction head. The distance field provides dense geometric supervision around object boundaries, encouraging the network to learn spatially consistent representations of spacecraft structures while maintaining low model complexity suitable for onboard perception systems. We evaluated GABI against both an established convolutional baseline and a heavier transformer-based architecture. On the SPARK benchmark, distance-field supervision improves the baseline by up to $5\%$ in Average Precision while achieving performance comparable to the transformer models. In generalization experiments, GABI improves Average Precision by more than $50\%$ over the baseline. In cross-domain evaluation, the lightweight GABI variant performs within $5\%$ in IoU and F1-score of the heavier transformer model while being approximately ten times smaller. At the same time, the heavier GABI variant surpasses the transformer architectures while remaining nearly three times lighter.

</details>


### [102] [Cohort-Scale Neural Atlases of Ultrasound Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00890)
*Zhuorui Zhang,Roger Pallarès-López,Xuan Wu,Praneeth Namburi,Brian W. Anthony*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向超声视频的群组级神经图谱（cohort-scale neural atlas），通过一个共享的规范坐标系和每视频的生成性潜在优化嵌入，在DINOv3特征空间中对数千帧进行联合训练，实现高效准确的标注迁移，并在多个心脏和肌肉骨骼数据集上验证了其与强基线方法相当的少样本学习性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声视频逐帧人工标注成本高、专家标签稀缺，且图像外观因散斑、阴影、衰减和操作者探头姿态而高度变化；现有神经图谱方法主要针对单视频或小规模图像集，缺乏面向群组级超声视频的解决方案。

Method: 构建一个单一规范图谱，结合每视频的生成性潜在优化（GLO）嵌入，在DINOv3特征空间中对数千帧进行联合训练，实现跨视频的协同表征学习。

Result: 在EchoNet-Dynamic和MSK-Bone等五个数据集上，该方法在单样本和少样本标注迁移中取得了与强密集对应基线方法竞争的精度，训练仅需数分钟（单张消费级GPU）。

Conclusion: 群组级神经图谱为超声视频分析提供了一种实用、可解释的表征方式，能够有效减轻专家标注负担。

Abstract: Ultrasound is the most widely used real-time imaging modality in clinical practice, yet per-frame video annotation remains a major bottleneck: expert labels are scarce and costly, and image appearance varies with speckle, shadowing, attenuation, and operator-dependent probe pose. This is especially limiting because clinically relevant information is often dynamic, from left-ventricular motion in echocardiography to muscle and bone kinematics in musculoskeletal imaging. Population atlases can amortize annotation cost by registering observations to a shared canonical coordinate system, but existing neural atlas methods mainly target single videos, small test-time image sets, or object-centric image collections. We introduce a cohort-scale neural atlas for ultrasound video: a single canonical chart with per-video Generative Latent Optimization embeddings, trained jointly over thousands of frames in DINOv3 feature space. Across five cardiac and musculoskeletal datasets with point landmarks and segmentation masks, our method learns coherent canonical templates and enables accurate atlas-space annotation transfer. On EchoNet-Dynamic and MSK-Bone, it supports single- and few-shot transfer with accuracy competitive with strong dense-correspondence baselines, while training in minutes on a single consumer GPU. The learned embeddings are interpretable: linear projections reveal structured cohort variation, image-decoder interpolation produces anatomically plausible intermediate frames, and test-time latent inversion reconstructs held-out frames through the atlas. These results suggest that cohort-scale neural atlases offer a practical, interpretable representation for reducing expert annotation burden in ultrasound video analysis.

</details>


### [103] [MMDG-Bench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00891)
*Qianshan Zhan,Qian Wang,Da Li,Xiao-Jun Zeng,Xiatian Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MMDG-Bench，一个多模态域泛化基准框架，包含D2M（先域泛化后多模态学习）和M2D（先多模态学习后域泛化）两种范式，在多个任务上统一评估协议，发现结构化组合优于现有SOTA，并给出三个关键洞见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态域泛化（MMDG）虽重要，但当前研究局限在动作识别领域，缺乏标准化评估协议，且多模态学习与域泛化的系统整合尚未被充分探索。

Method: 构建MMDG-Bench基准，提出D2M和M2D两种框架顺序范式，统一视频-音频-光流动作识别和RGB-Depth-IR人脸防伪等任务的评估协议，通过配对统一多模态配置与五种域泛化技术实例化十个基线。

Result: 结构化组合（D2M/M2D+DG技术）常优于现有SOTA；非DG方法对骨干网络变化高度敏感；最佳框架选择取决于模态间跨域稳定性；更强骨干在结构化框架中收益放大。

Conclusion: MMDG-Bench为多模态鲁棒性研究提供了原则性基础与可操作的设计指南，强调标准化基准对推动该领域系统性发展的必要性。

Abstract: Multi-modal Domain Generalization (MMDG) seeks to leverage complementary modalities to enhance model robustness on unseen domains. Despite extensive progress in Multi-modal Learning (MML) and Domain Generalization (DG) as individual fields, their systematic integration remains under-explored. Current MMDG research is largely confined to action recognition and lacks standardized evaluation protocols. To address this, we introduce MMDG-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring two foundational frameworks: DG then MML (D2M) and MML then DG (M2D). We provide unified experimental protocols across diverse tasks, including video-audio-flow action recognition and RGB-Depth-IR face anti-spoofing. By instantiating ten MMDG baselines through pairing a unified MML configuration with five DG techniques under both D2M and M2D orderings, we demonstrate that these structured combinations frequently outperform existing state-of-the-art methods, underscoring the necessity of a unified benchmarking effort. Our analysis yields three key insights: (1) Integrating DG techniques provides consistent generalization gains across various backbones, whereas non-DG methods are highly sensitive to backbone shifts; (2) The optimal framework choice depends on inter-modal stability: D2M excels when modal relations are stable across domains, while M2D is more robust to cross-domain relational variance; (3) Stronger backbones yield amplified performance dividends when integrated into our structured frameworks. MMDG-Bench provides a principled foundation and actionable design guidelines for future research in multi-modal robustness. Code is released at https://github.com/qszhan/MMDG-Bench.

</details>


### [104] [hZACH-ViT: Curved Latent Geometry for Compact Vision Transformers in Low-Data Medical Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00906)
*Athanasios Angelakis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出hZACH-ViT，一种将ZACH-ViT扩展至非欧几里得几何（双曲、球面）的紧凑视觉Transformer，在MedMNIST七数据集上验证了几何和曲率作为数据集依赖的超参数的价值，平均提升+0.021。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的紧凑视觉Transformer大多假设欧几里得潜几何足以组织图像表示，但在低数据和资源受限的医学影像场景下，非欧几何可能更优，而这一方向缺乏系统研究。

Method: 保留ZACH-ViT骨干不变，仅修改最终表示空间和基于原型的分类头，分别引入庞加莱、克莱因和球面三种非欧几何变体，在MedMNIST七个数据集上进行小样本（每类50样本）对比实验。

Result: 在全部七个数据集上，最佳非欧配置均优于欧几里得基线，平均主指标提升+0.021，其中OCTMNIST提升最大（+0.055 MacroF1）。低曲率（c=0.1或0.2）在六个数据集上取得最优。

Conclusion: 不存在普适最优的流形，几何和曲率应作为数据集依赖的模型选择变量，低曲率固定配置即可在多数数据集上保持增益。

Abstract: Compact Vision Transformers are attractive for medical imaging in low-data and resource-constrained settings, but most existing variants assume that Euclidean latent geometry is sufficient for organizing image representations. We introduce hZACH-ViT, a family of curved-geometry extensions of ZACH-ViT, a compact zero-token Vision Transformer that removes positional embeddings and the class token and relies on global average pooling over patch representations. To isolate the role of geometry, we preserve the verified ZACH-ViT backbone and modify only the final representation space and prototype-based classifier head, enabling a controlled comparison between Euclidean, hyperbolic, and spherical latent geometries.
  We evaluate Poincaré, Klein, and spherical hZACH-ViT heads on seven MedMNIST datasets under an identical few-shot protocol with 50 samples per class and five random seeds. The completed benchmark contains 770 training runs spanning seven datasets, three non-Euclidean geometries, seven curvature magnitudes, and a Euclidean baseline. Across all seven datasets, the best non-Euclidean hZACH-ViT configuration improves over Euclidean ZACH-ViT, with an average gain of +0.021 in the dataset-specific primary metric and the largest improvement on OCTMNIST (+0.055 MacroF1). Fixed low-curvature configurations retain positive gains on the majority of datasets, and low curvature values (c = 0.1 or 0.2) account for six of the seven dataset-level winners.
  Rather than identifying a universally optimal manifold, our results establish geometry and curvature as dataset-dependent model-selection variables, with fixed low-curvature analyses confirming that gains persist beyond exhaustive per-dataset tuning.

</details>


### [105] [Reason, Retrieve, Re-rank: A Zero-Shot Reasoning-Aware Framework for Composed Video Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00910)
*Ali Alavi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: R3-CoVR是一个无需训练的零样本视频检索流水线，通过多模态大模型推理编辑后的视频状态、并用对比编码器检索+重排序，在CoVR-R挑战赛上达到91.9% R@1和98.2% R@10。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对CoVR-R任务（零样本组合视频检索），现有方法依赖监督训练或不适用于零样本场景，作者希望构建一个完全无需训练、仅由冻结基础模型组成的流水线，实现高效且准确的推理式视频检索。

Method: 提出R3-CoVR流水线，包含三个阶段：①多模态大模型（Qwen3-VL-8B）推理编辑后的“after-effects”（状态变化、动作阶段、场景、镜头、节奏等），生成简洁的后编辑描述；②对比式视频-文本编码器（SigLIP-2）对该描述与候选集进行第一阶段检索；③利用同一个多模态大模型作为裁判，对短名单中的候选视频进行约束感知重排序。

Result: 在挑战测试集上，R3-CoVR达到91.9% R@1和98.2% R@10；其中描述长度匹配编码器窗口使R@1从67.5提升到72.7，约束感知重排序进一步从72.7提升到91.9，是最大增益来源。

Conclusion: 研究表明，零样本组合视频检索可以通过冻结大模型的有效组合实现SOTA性能，关键设计在于匹配描述长度与编码器窗口、以及引入基于大模型裁判的重排序机制。

Abstract: Composed Video Retrieval (CoVR) seeks the target video that results from applying a free-form textual modification to a reference video. We address the \emph{Reason-Aware} CoVR (CoVR-R) challenge at the CVPR~2026 VidLLMs workshop, where retrieval is strictly zero-shot. We present \textbf{R3-CoVR} (\emph{Reason, Retrieve, Re-rank}), a training-free pipeline built entirely from frozen foundation models. A multimodal large language model (Qwen3-VL-8B) reasons about the \emph{after-effects} an edit implies -- state transitions, action phases, scene, camera and tempo -- and verbalises a concise post-edit description; a contrastive video--text encoder (SigLIP-2) embeds this description and the gallery for first-stage retrieval; finally a constraint-aware re-ranking stage uses the same multimodal model as a judge that scores each shortlisted candidate against the intended edited result. On the challenge test set, R3-CoVR attains \textbf{91.9\% R@1} and \textbf{98.2\% R@10}. Two findings drive these results: (i)~matching the description length to the contrastive encoder's text window lifts \Rk{1} from $67.5$ to $72.7$; and (ii)~the constraint-aware re-ranker, which reorders only the shortlist, lifts \Rk{1} from $72.7$ to $91.9$ -- the single largest gain. We analyse the re-ranker's behaviour, the retrieve/re-rank blend, and the shortlist depth, and we release a clean three-layer implementation.

</details>


### [106] [Bridging Topology and Deep Representation Learning: A TDA-ViT Fusion Model for Four-Class Brain Tumor Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00927)
*Faisal Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种融合拓扑数据分析（TDA）与预训练Vision Transformer（ViT）特征的脑肿瘤分类框架，在四分类任务中达到99.10%的准确率，显著优于单独使用任一方法及多个SOTA模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Vision Transformer在医学图像分析中虽能学习全局上下文表征，但难以捕捉肿瘤区域内在的结构和拓扑模式，限制了分类性能的提升。

Method: 利用TDA从MRI图像提取拓扑描述子（几何结构、连通性、形状信息），同时用预训练ViT学习高层语义特征，将两者融合形成统一的判别性表征进行分类。

Result: 在BRISC2025四分类数据集上，TDA-ViT融合模型达到Accuracy 99.10%、Precision 99.27%、Recall 99.15%、F1-score 99.21%、AUC 99.98%，超越ResNet50/101、EfficientNetB2及纯ViT。

Conclusion: 拓扑特征为深度学习表征提供了有价值的互补信息，融合框架在脑肿瘤自动分类中兼具鲁棒性和高准确率。

Abstract: Accurate brain tumor classification from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a key requirement for early diagnosis and clinical decision-making. Vision Transformers (ViTs) have shown strong performance in medical image analysis by learning global contextual representations, but they often fail to capture intrinsic structural and topological patterns present in tumor regions. To address this limitation, we propose a fusion framework that combines Topological Data Analysis (TDA) features with pretrained Vision Transformer representations for four-class brain tumor classification.
  In the proposed method, TDA is used to extract complementary topological descriptors that capture geometric structure, connectivity, and shape information from MRI images. In parallel, a pretrained ViT model learns high-level semantic representations from the same images. These two feature spaces are then fused to form a unified and more discriminative representation for classification.
  The model is evaluated on the BRISC2025 dataset, which contains four brain tumor classes: glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and non-tumor cases. Experimental results show that combining topological and transformer-based features significantly improves performance compared to using either approach alone. The proposed TDA-ViT fusion model achieves an accuracy of 99.10%, precision of 99.27%, recall of 99.15%, F1-score of 99.21%, and an AUC of 99.98%. It also outperforms several state-of-the-art models, including ResNet50, ResNet101, EfficientNetB2, and standalone Vision Transformers. These results demonstrate that topological features provide valuable complementary information that enhances deep representation learning, leading to a robust and highly accurate framework for automated brain tumor classification.

</details>


### [107] [Single-Channel Tissue Segmentation via Cross-Modal Distillation from Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00928)
*Sakib Mohammad,Jarin Ritu,Md Sakhawat Hossain*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出跨模态知识蒸馏框架，将多通道荧光显微图像（含核与膜标记）的语义知识从冻结的SAM ViT-H教师模型蒸馏到仅使用核通道（DAPI）的轻量级学生网络（如Swin-Tiny, 27M参数），在TissueNet数据集上学生网络Dice达78.36，较无蒸馏基线提升13.05点，以23倍参数缩减恢复教师87.9%性能，且蒸馏效果在不同架构学生上均提升约12个Dice点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多通道荧光显微图像虽能提供更丰富的空间信息，但多通道模型在推理时需要所有通道输入，限制了仅部分通道可用场景下的部署。因此需要一种方法，使仅使用单一核通道的轻量模型也能获得接近多通道模型的分割性能。

Method: 提出跨模态知识蒸馏框架：(1) 使用冻结的SAM ViT-H或CellSAM作为教师模型，接收多通道输入；(2) 轻量级U-Net学生模型仅接收核通道输入；(3) 蒸馏目标结合MSE概率匹配损失、边界感知损失和可学习不确定性加权；(4) 评估四种学生网络：Swin-Tiny(27M)、ResNet18(11M)、EfficientNet-B0(5.3M)、MobileNetV3(1.5M)。

Result: TissueNet上SAM蒸馏的Swin-Tiny学生Dice 78.36±1.44，比无蒸馏基线(65.31±1.35)提升13.05点，达到教师性能(89.12±1.21)的87.9%，参数减少23倍。蒸馏对所有四种学生网络均提升约12个Dice点。SAM ViT-H教师优于CellSAM。BBBC038跨数据集评估显示一致增益。

Conclusion: 跨模态知识蒸馏能有效将多通道知识迁移到单通道轻量网络，实现架构无关的性能提升，为实际部署中仅核通道可用场景提供了可行且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Multiplexed fluorescence microscopy improves tissue segmentation by providing complementary channels including nuclear (DAPI) and membrane (E-cadherin), that together encode richer spatial context than single-channel imaging alone. However, multiplexed models require all channels at inference, limiting deployment where only a subset is available. This work proposes a cross-modal knowledge distillation framework that transfers semantic information from a frozen foundation model teacher processing multiplexed input to a lightweight student operating on the nuclear channel only. The distillation objective combines MSE-based probability matching, boundary-aware supervision, and learnable uncertainty weighting. SAM ViT-H and CellSAM are evaluated as teachers across four U-Net students: Swin-Tiny (27M), ResNet18 (11M), EfficientNet-B0 (5.3M), and MobileNetV3 (1.5M), on TissueNet and BBBC038. On TissueNet, the SAM-distilled Swin-Tiny student achieves Dice 78.36 (plus or minus 1.44), a 13.05-point improvement over the no-KD baseline (65.31 plus or minus 1.35) and 87.9% recovery of teacher oracle performance (89.12 plus or minus 1.21) at a 23x parameter reduction. KD consistently improves all four students by approximately 12 Dice points, confirming architecture-agnostic distillation. SAM ViT-H outperforms CellSAM as teacher across all settings. Cross-dataset evaluation on BBBC038 shows consistent gains without teacher retraining.

</details>


### [108] [CV-Arena: An Open Benchmark for Instructional Computer Vision Problem Solving with Human-AI Collaborative Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00931)
*Fangzhou Lin,Peiran Li,Lingyu Xu,Wenjing Chen,Qianwen Ge,Shuo Xing,Mingyang Wu,Xiangbo Gao,Siyuan Yang,Kazunori Yamada,Ziming Zhang,Haichong Zhang,Zhen Dong,Ming-Hsuan Yang,Zhengzhong Tu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CV-Arena基准，包含12K高分辨率真实图像编辑对，涵盖16种视觉任务类型；同时提出Active Elo评估协议和CV-Agent轻量级代理模型，系统评估21个模型后发现指令遵循、物理推理、结构控制等方面仍存在显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像编辑基准局限于狭义的外观编辑，无法捕捉专业工作流中真实图像任务的多样性。作者希望更广泛地定义"指令式计算机视觉问题求解"，涵盖显式保留、几何、物理和可用性约束，并为此构建大规模专业级基准。

Method: (1) CV-Arena：12K高分辨率真实图像-指令对，16种任务类型，通过CogRetriever双轨检索-整理流水线构建；(2) Active Elo：结合CV-Judge逻辑门控多维VLM评估器+人工专家评审的人机协作偏好协议；(3) CV-Agent：集规划、编辑、验证于一体的轻量级代理模型，实现闭环推理。

Result: 对21个系统（专有、开源、代理模型）的全面评估显示：指令遵循、物理推理、结构控制、细粒度细节保留方面存在持续差距。CV-Agent在专业级指令跟随视觉编辑中展现出有前景的方向。

Conclusion: 现有模型在专业级图像编辑任务中仍存在明显不足，闭环推理（如CV-Agent）是实现专业级指令式视觉编辑的有前途方向。CV-Arena基准和Active Elo协议为未来研究提供了可靠的评估框架。

Abstract: Instruction-guided image editing is becoming a general interface for visual work, yet existing benchmarks still focus largely on narrow appearance edits and do not fully capture the diversity of real-image tasks in professional workflows. Here, we define instructional computer vision problem solving as a broader formulation of image editing: given a real input image and a natural-language instruction, a system must produce an edited output that realizes the requested transformation while satisfying explicit preservation, geometric, physical, and usability constraints. We introduce CV-Arena, an open benchmark designed to evaluate this capability at professional scales. CV-Arena contains 12K high-resolution real-image instruction pairs spanning 16 instruction-based visual task types, constructed using CogRetriever, a dual-track retrieval-and-curation pipeline that combines targeted web search, agentic query refinement, verification, and traceability. To evaluate models at scale while preserving human fidelity, we propose Active Elo, a human-AI collaborative preference protocol that leverages CV-Judge, a logic-gated, multi-dimensional VLM evaluator, to reject clear failures and resolve high-confidence comparisons; and to route close, high-quality comparisons to expert raters. Mixed human and AI supervision is then aggregated through reliability-weighted Elo updates. Our comprehensive evaluation of 21 systems, including proprietary, open-source, and agentic models, on CV-Arena reveals persistent gaps in instruction adherence, physical reasoning, structural control, and fine-grained detail preservation. We further develop CV-Agent, a lightweight agentic model that combines planning, editing, and verification, and demonstrate that closed-loop reasoning is a promising direction for professional-grade instruction-following visual editing.

</details>


### [109] [One Channel to Rule Them All: Rethinking Input Representation for Visual Place Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00936)
*Timur Ismagilov,Shakaiba Majeed,Michael Milford,Tan Viet Tuyen Nguyen,Sarvapali D. Ramchurn,Shoaib Ehsan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文质疑视觉位置识别（VPR）中彩色信息的必要性，实验表明灰度图像在多数场景下表现不逊于甚至优于RGB，尤其在光照、季节等外观剧烈变化时。灰度模型在MixVPR上Recall@1达82.4%，优于RGB的81.2%，且轻量级灰度模型可超越更重的RGB模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战"彩色信息对全局位置识别是必要的"这一隐含假设，探究颜色信息在VPR中的真正作用。

Method: 在不同训练方式、模型架构和标准基准上，对比灰度与RGB输入在真实外观变化下的表现，使用MixVPR等模型进行实验。

Result: 灰度模型平均Recall@1为82.4%，RGB为81.2%；部分轻量级灰度模型（参数减少60%）可超越更重的RGB模型。

Conclusion: 在光照、天气、季节、环境变化的全局VPR中，颜色贡献极小，灰度图像足以实现可靠的位置识别，且具有存储、带宽和资源受限系统的实际优势。

Abstract: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is fundamental to long-term robot localization and SLAM, yet current systems overwhelmingly rely on RGB input, implicitly assuming color is necessary for global place recognition. We challenge this assumption, investigating the role of chromatic information across training regimes, model architectures and standard benchmarks under real-world appearance variation. We find that grayscale matches RGB performance generally and outperforms it under severe appearance shifts where color invariance is insufficiently learned, while color provides meaningful gains only where persistent and discriminative chromatic cues are present. Across selected benchmarks, a fully gray-trained MixVPR model achieves an average 82.4% Recall@1 compared to 81.2% for its RGB counterpart. In some cases, lightweight grayscale variants with 60% fewer parameters can outperform heavier RGB models. Grayscale further offers practical advantages in storage, bandwidth and alignment with resource-constrained systems. We conclude that for global VPR where scenes vary across illumination, weather, season and setting, color contributes minimally, and grayscale alone is sufficient for reliable place recognition.

</details>


### [110] [COLLAR: Cascaded Object-Level Latent Refinement for High-Fidelity Conditional Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00954)
*Xinlong Zhang,Jia Wei,Xiaoyu Zhang,Teng Zhou,Chengyu Lin,Yongchuan Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出COLLAR框架，一种无需训练的渐进式对象级特征优化方法，通过FoV扩展和两个核心模块（CSSA和CFI）在扩散Transformer中实现高保真对象级控制，在COCO基准上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer中的对象级控制存在视觉伪影和局部区域控制不精确的问题，当前方法受限于此。

Method: 提出COLLAR框架，包含(1) Cross-Scale Semantic Alignment (CSSA)模块，通过注意力机制将对象级特征注入扩展FoV分支，解决空间-语义鸿沟；(2) Cyclic Feature Injection (CFI)模块，利用频域自适应策略的互反馈机制，用上下文对齐的局部信息选择性更新全局主干。

Result: 在COCO-MIG和COCO-POS基准上，在语义对齐、图像质量和空间保真度方面一致优于最先进方法。

Conclusion: COLLAR框架通过训练自由的渐进式优化和FoV扩展，有效解决了对象级条件生成中的视觉伪影和控制精度问题。

Abstract: Achieving high-fidelity object-level control in Diffusion Transformers remains a significant challenge despite the introduction of structural priors like depth and Canny maps. Current object-level conditional generation methods frequently suffer from visual artifacts and struggle to maintain precise control over objects within small localized regions. To address these limitations, we propose Cascaded Object-Level Latent Refinement (COLLAR), a training-free framework that progressively optimizes object-level features via the Field-of-View (FoV) expansion. First, we propose the Cross-Scale Semantic Alignment (CSSA) module to address spatial-semantic gaps by injecting object-level features into extended-FoV branches via attention mechanisms. To further optimize these features, the Cyclic Feature Injection (CFI) module introduces a reciprocal background feedback mechanism. It leverages a frequency-based adaptive strategy to selectively update the global backbone with context-aligned local information. Finally, the extended-FoV branch serves as a hub for feature optimization, ensuring that object-level features are integrated into the global generation process without compromising final image quality. Extensive experiments on the COCO-MIG and COCO-POS benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across semantic alignment, image quality, and spatial fidelity.

</details>


### [111] [Boundary-Protection W8A8 HiFloat8 Quantization for Large-Scale Text-to-Video Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00957)
*Yiming Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对Wan2.1-T2V-14B视频扩散Transformer模型，提出了一种面向Ascend 910B NPU的W8A8 HiF8后训练量化方法。通过分析40个注意力块中边界块与中间块的异构激活分布，采用保留前2块和后3块为BF16、其余35块量化为HiF8的边界保护策略，在5个VBench指标上匹配甚至超越BF16基线，并验证了全边界保护配置最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频DiT模型中不同Transformer块的激活分布存在显著异构性：边界块（前几个和后几个块）与中间块的统计特性根本不同，导致统一量化策略效果不佳。

Method: 1）对40个WanAttentionBlock逐块激活分析；2）提出边界保护策略：保留前2块和后3块为BF16，其余35块采用W8A8 HiF8量化；3）研究了量化感知训练（QAT）作为补充微调阶段的条件。

Result: 在5个VBench维度上匹配或略超BF16基线，在5-prompt评估集内无显著精度损失；消融实验验证全边界保护配置平均VBench得分最高。

Conclusion: 基于数据驱动的边界块选择策略是有效的，全边界保护配置最优；QAT在单卡硬件上未能超越纯PTQ。

Abstract: We present a post-training quantization (PTQ) approach for Wan2.1-T2V-14B, a 14-billion-parameter text-to-video diffusion transformer, targeting the W8A8 HiFloat8 (HiF8) format on Ascend 910B NPUs. A central challenge in quantizing video DiT models is the heterogeneous activation distribution across transformer blocks: boundary blocks (the first and last few blocks) exhibit fundamentally different statistical properties from middle blocks, making uniform quantization ineffective. We conduct a systematic per-block activation analysis across all 40 WanAttentionBlocks and use the findings to motivate a boundary-protection strategy that retains the first two and last three blocks in BF16 while quantizing the remaining 35 blocks with W8A8 HiF8. The proposed PTQ method matches or marginally exceeds the BF16 baseline on all five VBench dimensions evaluated, indicating no measurable accuracy loss within the 5-prompt evaluation set. An ablation study over four protection configurations confirms that full boundary protection yields the highest average VBench score, validating the data-driven block selection. We additionally investigate quantization-aware training (QAT) as a complementary fine-tuning stage and analyze the conditions under which it fails to outperform plain PTQ on single-card hardware.

</details>


### [112] [Reasmory: 3D Reconstruction as Explicit Memory for VLMs Spatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00963)
*Jixuan He,Xueting Li,Chieh Hubert Lin,Ming-Hsuan Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Reasmory框架通过结构化程序执行和领域特定语言（DSL）约束，在重建的3D空间记忆上进行推理，相比自由形式工具调用，在多视图图像和视频空间推理任务上取得了6-18%的持续提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在精确空间理解（视点推理、方向比较、距离估计）上不可靠，自由形式工具调用容易导致错误使用或误用中间结果。

Method: 构建显式3D记忆并增强语义3D实例，引入轻量级DSL约束VLM查询对象、相机、视点变换和渲染操作，生成的程序在执行前经过解析和验证。

Result: 在多视图图像和视频空间推理基准上，相比GPT-5-mini和Gemini-3-flash等强基线，获得6-18%的一致提升。

Conclusion: 显式3D记忆在通过受约束、可验证的操作访问时最有效，而非自由形式的工具调用。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit emerging spatial reasoning capabilities, yet they remain unreliable on tasks requiring precise spatial understanding, such as viewpoint reasoning, directional comparison, and distance estimation. In multi-view images and monocular videos, relevant spatial cues are often sparse and distributed across redundant observations, making them difficult to organize and exploit. Reconstruction-based Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) offer a natural way to aggregate such observations into explicit spatial memory, such as point clouds. However, simply exposing reconstruction models as free-form tools is brittle, VLMs may invoke tools incorrectly, skip required spatial transformations, or misuse intermediate results. We propose \textbf{Reasmory}, a framework that formulates spatial reasoning as structured program execution over reconstructed spatial memory. Reasmory constructs explicit 3D memory, augments it with semantically grounded 3D object instances, and introduces a lightweight Domain-Specific Language (DSL) that constrains how VLMs query objects and cameras, transform viewpoints, and render observations during reasoning. Generated programs are parsed and validated before execution, enabling more reliable interaction with spatial memory than unconstrained tool use. Experiments on multi-view image and video spatial reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains of 6--18\% over strong baselines, including GPT-5-mini and Gemini-3-flash, indicating that explicit 3D memory is most useful when accessed through constrained, validated operations rather than free-form tool calls.

</details>


### [113] [RoboTrustBench: Benchmarking the Trustworthiness of Video World Models for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01600)
*Huiqiong Li,Jiayu Wang,Zhiting Mei,Anirudha Majumdar,Jingjing Chen,Bin Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RoboTrustBench是评估视频世界模型在机器人操作中可信度的基准，包含1207个专家验证的指令-图像对和六维评估协议。测试发现现有模型虽能生成视觉连贯视频，但在约束推理、反事实、物理交互和危险指令抑制方面表现不佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人操作视频世界模型主要在有效、可行和安全的指令下评估，缺乏对模型在异常和危险场景下可信度的系统评估。

Method: 基于真实DROID数据构建1207个专家验证的指令-图像对，设计Normal、Constraint-Sensitive、Counterfactual、Adversarial四个场景，采用六维评估协议（含13个细粒度标准），结合人类和MLLM进行评估。

Result: 当前模型能生成视觉连贯视频，但在约束推理、反事实基础、物理交互和危险指令抑制方面存在明显不足。

Conclusion: 视觉质量和表面指令跟随不足以确保可信的机器人视频世界建模，需要更强的推理和安全性能力。

Abstract: Video world models are increasingly used in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mostly evaluate them under valid, feasible, and safe instructions. We introduce RoboTrustBench, a benchmark for evaluating the trustworthiness of video world models under four scenarios: Normal, Constraint-Sensitive, Counterfactual, and Adversarial. Built from real-world DROID episodes, RoboTrustBench contains 1,207 expert-validated instruction-image pairs and a six-dimensional evaluation protocol with 13 fine-grained criteria. Evaluating seven representative video world models with human and MLLM assessment, we find that current models often generate visually coherent videos, but struggle with constraint reasoning, counterfactual grounding, physical interaction, and unsafe-instruction suppression. These results show that visual quality and surface-level instruction following are insufficient for trustworthy robotic video world modeling.

</details>


### [114] [Flexible Control of 3D CT Generation via Text and Semantically-Defined Segmentation Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00967)
*Weicheng Dai,Chenyu Wang,Andy Li,Shantanu Ghosh,Kayhan Batmanghelich*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种灵活的多模态可控体积医学图像生成框架，支持放射学报告和分割提示作为输入（均可选），无需完整器官标注，通过改进的扩散Transformer架构实现高分辨率CT体积生成，在感知和语义指标上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可控医学图像生成方法存在两难：基于文本提示灵活性高但空间控制弱；基于分割提示空间精确但需要完整器官标注，缺乏灵活性与可扩展性。

Method: 提出多模态控制框架，支持放射学报告和部分分割掩码（无需完整器官标注）作为条件输入；分割掩码的语义通过文本描述指定；采用改进的扩散Transformer架构，联合处理图像和分割token，并引入门控注意力机制处理长文本报告。

Result: 在感知和语义指标上达到SOTA（平均FID相对提升24%），生成高分辨率、解剖结构一致的CT体积；作为数据增强可提升数据效率；放射科医师评估确认生成图像与真实医学图像高度一致。

Conclusion: 提出的灵活多模态框架有效解决了文本控制与分割控制之间的权衡，在无需完整器官标注的情况下实现了兼具灵活性和精确空间控制的可控体积医学图像生成。

Abstract: Generative models for volumetric medical images have found many applications in medical imaging, ranging from data augmentation to serving as priors for inverse problems. For these applications, generating high-resolution 3D images with strong controllability is essential but remains highly challenging. Existing approaches typically control generation either through radiology reports used as text prompts or through full image segmentation. While text-based prompting is flexible, it provides limited spatial control over the location, shape, and boundary of abnormalities. In contrast, segmentation-based methods receive precise spatial guidance but are restrictive in requiring full-organ annotations. In this work, we propose a flexible multimodal framework for controllable volumetric image generation that supports input from radiology reports and segmentation prompts (both optional). Our approach allows users to provide segmentation of a specific anatomy or abnormality without requiring full-organ annotations. The semantic meaning of the segmentation mask is specified through an accompanying text description, resulting in a highly flexible and scalable conditioning mechanism. We develop a memory-efficient architecture based on a modified diffusion transformer that jointly processes image and segmentation tokens. The model further incorporates gated attention to effectively attend to long radiology reports. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art perceptual and semantic scores (e.g., 24% relative improvement in mean FID), generates high-resolution anatomically consistent CT volumes, and improves data efficiency when used for data augmentation. Radiologists' evaluation further confirms strong alignment between generated and real medical images.

</details>


### [115] [Goal2Pixel: Grounding Goals to Pixels for Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01621)
*Muyi Bao,Yuxin Cai,Hang Xu,Zongtai Li,Jinxi He,Jingfan Tang,Chen Lv,Ji Zhang,Yaqi Xie,Wenshan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Goal2Pixel将VLN-CE任务从低层动作预测转变为可导航像素定位范式，通过在图像平面上预测目标像素并反向投影为3D航点来实现导航，仅需7.75次VLM调用即可在R2R-CE上达到54.1%的SR，比传统方法减少6倍推理次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM-based VLN方法将导航视为低层动作预测，存在接口模糊、受限于短视运动基元、且因反复查询VLM而导致效率低下的问题。

Method: 提出纯像素范式Goal2Pixel：1）将图像平面作为统一空间接口，预测可见可导航像素并反向投影为3D航点；2）在图像边缘添加辅助指令区域（左/右/底）处理非前向动作；3）提出可见性感知的关键帧记忆用于长程导航；4）引入语义嵌入和坐标感知辅助损失以适配预训练VLM。

Result: R2R-CE Val-Unseen上达到54.1% SR和52.5% SPL，仅需7.75次VLM调用/片段（传统方法46.62次调用仅32.9% SR），效率提升6倍；在RxR-CE上也取得一致优势。

Conclusion: Goal2Pixel通过将导航重新定义为像素级定位任务，显著降低了VLM推理开销，同时实现了竞争性的SOTA性能，验证了纯像素范式的有效性。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a common foundation for vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE). Yet most VLM-based methods cast navigation as low-level action prediction, an interface that is ambiguous, tied to short-horizon motion primitives, and inefficient due to repeated VLM querying. We propose Goal2Pixel, a pure pixel-based paradigm that reformulates VLN-CE as navigable pixel grounding. Rather than predicting actions, Goal2Pixel uses the image plane as a unified spatial interface between VLM reasoning and robot motion: the model predicts a visible navigable pixel to the agent, which is back-projected into a 3D waypoint for forward navigation. For non-forward actions, we append auxiliary directive regions to the image plane, where the left/right/bottom regions are interpreted as turning left, turning right, and stopping, respectively. To enable long-horizon navigation, we propose a visibility-aware keyframe memory for compact and informative history representation. To adapt pretrained VLMs to navigable pixel grounding, we introduce semantic embeddings and coordinate-aware auxiliary losses. Goal2Pixel achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance while requiring fewer VLM inference calls than prior methods. On R2R-CE Val-Unseen it achieves 54.1% SR and 52.5% SPL with just 7.75 VLM calls per episode, 6x fewer than the 46.62 required by direct action prediction at 32.9% SR. The same trend holds on RxR-CE.Project Page: https://baobao0926.github.io/Goal2Pixel/.

</details>


### [116] [An Open-Source Benchmark and Baseline for Multi-temporal Referring Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00987)
*Bingyu Li,Da Zhang,Tao Huo,Zhiyuan Zhao,Junyu Gao,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了多时相指代分割（MTRS）新任务，要求模型从多时相图像中分割语言描述的时间变化。构建了自动化数据构建流水线CRAFT-Agent和首个基准数据集MTRefSeg-21K（21K三元组），并提出了两阶段训练的时相感知LVLM框架MTRefSeg-R1，实验表明其性能优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LVLM在视觉理解和语言引导方面表现优异，但对多时相视觉推理（如时间变化的分割）能力未被充分探索。为解决这一空白，作者提出了多时相指代分割（MTRS）任务。

Method: 1) 提出CRAFT-Agent自动化数据构建流水线（含人工审核），构建MTRefSeg-21K基准数据集；2) 提出MTRefSeg-R1框架，采用两阶段训练策略：先通过20K视觉仅时相双样本学习通用时间变化感知，再在MTRefSeg-21K上微调实现细粒度语言引导的时相定位；3) 显式建模跨时相视觉差异，对齐语言指令与时相变化，预测指代变化掩码。

Result: MTRefSeg-R1在MTRefSeg-21K基准上取得了强且通常优于现有LVLM基线的性能，表明MTRS任务的挑战性和潜力。

Conclusion: 多时相指代分割是一个具有挑战性的新任务，两阶段训练的时相感知LVLM框架能有效提升性能，但仍需进一步研究。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown strong visual understanding and language-guided grounding abilities, yet their capacity for multi-temporal visual reasoning remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{Multi-temporal Referring Segmentation (MTRS)}, a new task that aims to segment language-described temporal changes from multi-temporal images. MTRS extends conventional referring segmentation and change detection by jointly requiring temporal correspondence reasoning, language grounding, and pixel-level mask prediction. We propose \textbf{CRAFT-Agent}, an automated data construction pipeline with human auditing, and build \textbf{MTRefSeg-21K}, the first MTRS benchmark, containing 21K high-quality multi-temporal image-text-mask triplets across diverse scenes, viewpoints, and domains. Benchmarking a broad set of VLM- and LVLM-based models reveals that direct inference performs poorly, while task-specific fine-tuning remains limited. To address this, we propose \textbf{MTRefSeg-R1}, a change-aware LVLM framework trained with a two-stage strategy. It first learns general temporal-change perception from 20K vision-only bi-temporal samples, and is then fine-tuned on MTRefSeg-21K for fine-grained language-guided temporal localization. MTRefSeg-R1 explicitly models cross-temporal visual differences, aligns language instructions with temporal variations, and predicts referred change masks. Extensive experiments show that MTRefSeg-R1 achieves strong and often superior performance compared with existing LVLM baselines, demonstrating the challenge and potential of MTRS.

</details>


### [117] [FlatVPR: Plug-and-play Geo-linear Residual Adapter for Geometric Rectification of Foundation Model Feature Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01734)
*Rai Hisada,Kanji Tanaka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlatVPR提出了一种几何校正范式，通过线性插值重建特征描述符，并引入可学习适配器和Pullback Flatness Loss来抑制特征流形曲率，从而在视觉位置识别中平衡地图轻量化与定位精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基础模型（如DINOv2）的潜在流形具有显著曲率，导致稀疏锚点条件下无法可靠地进行线性插值重建，难以兼顾地图轻量化与定位精度。

Method: (1) 引入残差变换适配器对原始特征进行校正；(2) 提出Pullback Flatness Loss最小化中间特征偏离线性插值段的偏差；(3) 将地图构建形式化为期望最大化（EM）框架，解耦为连续M-step（流形适配）和概念E-step（最优锚点选择）。

Result: 在NCLT数据集上，即使在100米间隔的极端稀疏锚点和剧烈季节变化条件下，该方法仍能取得显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: FlatVPR通过流形展平有效解决了稀疏锚点下的特征重建问题，为轻量化高精度VPR提供了新范式。

Abstract: This paper proposes ``FlatVPR,'' a novel geometric rectification paradigm that effectively bridges the trade-off between map lightweightness and localization accuracy in visual place recognition (VPR) by enforcing a feature manifold structure where any descriptor between two adjacent anchors $\mathbf{z}_A$ and $\mathbf{z}_B$ can be accurately reconstructed via linear interpolation $\hat{\mathbf{z}}_{pseudo} = (1-t)\mathbf{z}_A + t\mathbf{z}_B$, where $t \in [0,1]$ denotes the relative position. While state-of-the-art foundation models such as DINOv2-ViT-S/14 provide robust semantic features, their latent manifolds exhibit prominent curvature, projecting uniform linear motion in physical space onto highly non-linear trajectories in the feature space, which hinders reliable reconstruction under sparse anchor conditions. To enable the aforementioned interpolation-based reconstruction, we introduce a residual transformation $\hat{\mathbf{z}} = \mathbf{z} + \text{Res}(\mathbf{z})$ to the raw foundation features $\mathbf{z}$, where $\text{Res}(\cdot)$ represents a learnable adapter. Our method explicitly suppresses manifold curvature using a mathematically grounded Pullback Flatness Loss that minimizes the deviation of intermediate features from the linear segment connecting adjacent anchors, thereby minimizing the intrinsic curvature of the manifold. Through this spatial flattening, map construction is formulated within an Expectation-Maximization (EM) framework, decoupled into a continuous M-step for manifold adaptation and a conceptual E-step for optimal anchor selection guidelines. Experiments on the NCLT dataset demonstrate that the application of our adapter leads to significant performance improvements even under extremely sparse anchor conditions with 100m intervals and extreme seasonal changes.

</details>


### [118] [SWARD: Stochastic Window-Attention-Based Relational Distillation for Cross-Architectural Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00999)
*Aditya Makineni,Qing Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SWARD框架，通过多尺度窗口注意力蒸馏（MWAD）和原型判别正则化（PDR）两种互补机制，弥合Transformer教师网络与CNN学生网络之间的表征鸿沟，实现高效语义分割知识蒸馏，并在城市场景解析和医学图像分割任务上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉基础模型在语义分割等密集预测任务上表现优异，但模型过大难以部署在资源受限场景。知识蒸馏虽能将能力迁移至轻量学生网络，但现有方法假设师生网络架构同质（均为Transformer或均为CNN），忽视了Transformer教师（全局上下文）与CNN学生（局部偏置感受野）之间的表征鸿沟，且直接特征模仿无法捕捉结构化空间依赖和判别性组织。

Method: 提出SWARD框架，包含两个互补模块：(1) 多尺度窗口注意力蒸馏（MWAD），在随机移位窗口划分中对齐师生注意力关系，窗口偏移在每轮训练中随机重采样以消除边界偏置，多尺度设计捕获长短程空间依赖；(2) 原型判别正则化（PDR），通过强制类间分离和类内紧凑来塑造学生特征分布，增强判别性结构。

Result: 在城市场景解析和医学图像分割等多个视觉应用任务上，SWARD达到了最先进的性能（state-of-the-art）。

Conclusion: SWARD通过MWAD和PDR两种机制，有效解决了异构架构（Transformer教师→CNN学生）间的知识蒸馏难题，在资源受限场景下兼顾分割精度与模型轻量化，为语义分割蒸馏提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Large-scale vision foundation models have driven substantial gains on dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation, but their size makes deployment impractical in resource-constrained settings, motivating knowledge distillation as a means of transferring their capabilities to lightweight student networks. However, modern foundation teachers are predominantly transformer-based that encode global context, whereas efficient students are typically convolutional networks with locally biased receptive fields. Existing distillation methods largely assume architectural homogeneity and rely on direct feature mimicry, which fails to bridge this representational gap and neglects the structured spatial dependencies and discriminative organization required for accurate semantic segmentation. In this paper, we propose SWARD, a knowledge distillation framework that addresses this gap through two complementary mechanisms. First, we introduce a Multi-Scale Windowed Attention Distillation (MWAD) module that aligns teacher-student attention-based relations within stochastically shifted window partitions whose offsets are randomly resampled at every training iteration. This removes window boundary bias, and, combined with the multi-scale design, captures both short- and long-range spatial dependencies. Second, we introduce Prototype Discriminative Regularization (PDR), a loss that helps shape the student's feature distribution by enforcing inter-class separation and intra-class compactness, further sharpening the discriminative structure beyond what feature mimicry alone can produce under the student's reduced capacity. Experiments across different vision applications (i.e., urban scene parsing and medical image segmentation) show that SWARD achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [119] [TIDES: Time-Derivative Event Simulation via Deformable Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02058)
*Christopher Thirgood,Dipon Kumar Ghosh,Simon Hadfield*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TIDES是一个基于动态高斯溅射的连续时间事件相机模拟器，通过显式3D场景表示直接推导像素强度动态，实现精确的阈值交叉预测，并模拟有限传感器带宽，在事件流保真度和下游任务迁移性上达到最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事件相机模拟器大多从帧序列推断时间戳，导致"时间戳批处理"问题（多个阈值交叉共享少量离散时间），在快速运动和遮挡下尤为严重；且真实世界事件数据集稀缺，需要更准确的模拟方法。

Method: 基于动态高斯溅射构建连续时间场景表示，直接从3D场景学习几何和运动，逐像素推导强度动态；利用3D场景模型检测局部遮挡，引导自适应时间步长，仅在遮挡区域集中计算；采用tile级仲裁器建模有限传感器带宽，模拟吞吐量、抖动和事件丢失等真实传感器伪影。

Result: 在RGB-事件配对基准上，TIDES在事件流保真度上达到最先进水平；模拟的事件在真实下游任务上的迁移效果优于竞争方法。

Conclusion: TIDES通过连续时间建模和显式3D场景表示，从根本上解决了时间戳批处理问题，同时通过传感器建模提升了模拟事件的真实性和实用性。

Abstract: Event cameras emit asynchronous events in response to environmental appearance changes. The scarcity of real-world event datasets makes simulation essential. However, most simulators infer event timestamps from frame sequences, forcing many threshold crossings to share a small set of discrete times; a failure mode we term timestamp batching that worsens under fast motion and occlusion.
  We present TIDES, a continuous-time event simulator built on dynamic Gaussian splatting. Because TIDES operates on an explicit 3D scene representation with learnt geometry and motion, it can derive per-pixel intensity dynamics directly from the scene, rather than by differencing rendered frames. This enables accurate threshold-crossing prediction, including multiple crossings per rendering step, without temporal upsampling or frame interpolation. The same 3D scene model reveals where objects partially occlude one another; TIDES uses this to guide adaptive time stepping, concentrating computation only in regions where occlusion dynamics make simple models of brightness change unreliable.
  Finally, we model finite sensor bandwidth using a tile-level arbiter whose throughput, jitter, and event drops reproduce realistic sensor artifacts. Across paired RGB-event benchmarks, TIDES attains state-of-the-art event-stream fidelity. We also show that events simulated by TIDES transfer more effectively to real downstream tasks than competitors'.

</details>


### [120] [Automated Erythrocyte Detection and Tracking for Retinal Blood Flow Quantification in Erythrocyte-Mediated Angiography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01006)
*Chiao-Yi Wang,Havish S Gadde,Yi-Ting Shen,Saige M. Oechsli,Osamah Saeedi,Yang Tao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EMTrack框架，用于视网膜毛细血管血流成像中的红细胞自动检测与追踪，并建立RBF-EMA数据集，实验证明其在检测与追踪任务上优于基线方法，有望实现自动化视网膜血流测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 毛细血管级视网膜血流（RBF）是多种眼疾的重要生物标志物，但现有测量手段有限。红细胞介导血管造影（EMA）虽能实现毛细血管级血流测量，但红细胞的自动检测与追踪尚未被充分探索。

Method: 提出EMTrack框架，包含两个核心模块：1）流上下文模块（flow-context module），用于区分运动中的红细胞与静止细胞；2）拓扑感知追踪策略（topology-aware tracking strategy），应对大帧间位移和运动变化。

Result: 在自建RBF-EMA数据集上，EMTrack在红细胞检测与追踪任务上均显著优于基线方法，并实现了有效的视网膜血流定量测量。

Conclusion: EMTrack框架在自动化视网膜毛细血管血流测量方面展现出强大潜力，为眼疾生物标志物的临床评估提供了新工具。

Abstract: Capillary-level retinal blood flow (RBF) has strong potential as a biomarker for various ocular diseases. However, modalities for measuring capillary-level RBF remain limited. Erythrocyte-mediated angiography (EMA), an emerging imaging technique, enables capillary-level RBF measurement by visualizing individual erythrocytes, yet automated erythrocyte detection and tracking, which are essential for quantifying blood flow, remain largely unexplored. To address this gap, we propose EMTrack, a novel framework featuring a flow-context module for erythrocyte detection that distinguishes moving from paused cells and a topology-aware tracking strategy that enables tracking under large inter-frame displacements and substantial motion variations. In addition, we establish RBF-EMA, a new EMA dataset with comprehensive erythrocyte detection and tracking annotations. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms baseline methods both quantitatively and qualitatively on detection and tracking tasks in the RBF-EMA dataset. Moreover, RBF quantification results highlight the strong potential of our framework for automated retinal blood flow measurement.

</details>


### [121] [Not All Points Are Equal: Uncertainty-Aware 4D LiDAR Scene Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02510)
*Xiang Xu,Alan Liang,Youquan Liu,Xian Sun,Linfeng Li,Lingdong Kong,Ziwei Liu,Qingshan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: U4D提出了一种利用空间不确定性引导LiDAR场景生成的框架，通过"从难到易"的策略，先合成高不确定性区域（远距离、遮挡边界、小物体），再补全低不确定性区域，显著提升了4D场景的保真度和时间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成框架对所有空间区域使用统一建模能力，忽略了单次扫描中感知难度差异巨大（如远距离表面、遮挡边界、小物体具有高不确定性），导致复杂区域生成质量不佳。

Method: 1) 通过预训练分割器的Shannon熵导出逐点不确定性图；2) 无条件扩散阶段合成高熵区域；3) 条件补全过程以已合成结构为先验填充剩余区域；4) MoST模块动态平衡空间细节与时间连续性，维持跨帧一致性。

Result: 在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI数据集上，场景保真度、时间一致性和下游任务性能均达到最先进水平。

Conclusion: 显式利用空间不确定性来引导生成过程，能够有效提升LiDAR 4D场景重建的质量和一致性，为具身智能提供更可靠的感知基础。

Abstract: Constructing faithful 4D worlds from LiDAR-acquired sequences is crucial for embodied AI, yet current generative frameworks apply uniform modeling capacity across all spatial regions. This ignores that perceptual difficulty varies dramatically within a single scan: distant surfaces, occluded boundaries, and small-scale objects carry far higher uncertainty than well-observed structures. We present U4D, a new framework that explicitly leverages spatial uncertainty to guide LiDAR scene generation in a "hard-to-easy" schedule. U4D derives per-point uncertainty maps via Shannon Entropy from a pretrained segmentor, then applies an unconditional diffusion stage to synthesize high-entropy areas with precise geometry, followed by a conditional completion stage that fills in the remaining regions using these structures as priors. A MoST (Mixture of Spatio-Temporal) block further maintains cross-frame coherence by dynamically balancing spatial detail and temporal continuity. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and SemanticKITTI demonstrate state-of-the-art scene fidelity, temporal consistency, and downstream performance.

</details>


### [122] [Cross-Axis Feature Fusion with Joint-Wise Motion Difference Prediction for Text-Based 3D Human Motion Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01014)
*Gyojin Han,Junmo Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于文本的三维人体运动编辑方法，通过双轴锚定Transformer架构和辅助任务，在保留源运动风格和结构的同时，实现了更精确的关节级编辑，在MotionFix数据集上达到了SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法主要关注编辑发生的时间维度，忽略了哪些具体关节需要被修改。本文旨在构建一个不仅能理解编辑时机，还能理解哪些关节需要改变的运动编辑模型。

Method: 提出双轴锚定Transformer架构：关节锚定Transformer提取关节维度特征，时间锚定Transformer提取时间维度特征，以及跨轴融合模块整合两种表示。另设辅助任务：训练关节锚定Transformer回归源与目标关节旋转之间的Soft-DTW距离，使模型学会判断哪些关节需修改、哪些需保留。

Result: 在MotionFix数据集上的实验表明，该方法在文本指令与源运动的语义对齐以及生成运动的整体保真度方面均显著提升，达到当前最优水平。

Conclusion: 通过明确建模关节维度的编辑信息，双轴分离与融合的设计有效提升了文本驱动的3D人体运动编辑的精度和语义一致性。

Abstract: We address text-based 3D human motion editing, where the goal is to preserve the style and structure of a source motion while applying edits described in natural language. The release of the MotionFix dataset has spurred active research into training-based diffusion models that directly generate an edited motion from a source motion and a text instruction. While previous works have focused primarily on learning when an edit should occur temporally, our goal is to create a model that understands not only this temporal aspect but also which specific joints are responsible for the change.
