The scene is represented by Gaussian Process Implicit Surfaces (GPIS), with surface normals serving as derivative constraints, enabling accurate signed distance computations near the surface and gradient queries with uncertainty. With this representation as a foundation, we compute a scene flow from the distance field that describes how surface points are transported over time in consecutive frames. Through our flow, we can estimate an object's pose and motion by incrementally registering a new observed point cloud via an elegant closed-form optimisation. Unlike prior methods that operate in the camera or world frame, our approach performs probabilistic fusion directly in the \emph{object frame}, where the object remains geometrically consistent over time. The tight coupling of the DisFlow method in space and time yields dense geometry, surface normals, object pose trajectories, velocities, and uncertainty, all at real-time rates. We evaluate DisFlow on dynamic object sequences and demonstrate that it achieves accurate pose and motion tracking while simultaneously reconstructing high-quality object surfaces. Code publicly available at \href{https://github.com/LanWu076/disflow_ros2}{https://github.com/LanWu076/disflow\_ros2}

</details>


### [380] [The Lie We Tell: Correcting the Euclidean Fallacy in Vision Language Action Policies via Score Matching on Tangent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01847)
*Bing-Cheng Chuang,I-Hsuan Chu,Bor-Jiun Lin,YuanFu Yang,Min Sun,Chun-Yi Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Lie Diffuser Actor (LDA)，在SE(3)流形上直接进行扩散策略建模，解决了将SE(3)姿态视为平坦ℝ¹²向量所带来的"欧几里得谬误"（流形漂移、等变性破坏、非测地轨迹），在CALVIN ABC→D上任务长度从3.27提升至3.51（+7.3%），并在真实机器人上取得更好性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作策略将SE(3)位姿错误地当作平坦ℝ¹²向量处理，导致三个根本性几何错误：违反SO(3)约束的流形漂移、坐标变换下等变性破坏、生成非测地线轨迹导致过高运动学代价。

Method: 提出Lie Diffuser Actor (LDA)，在SE(3)李群上内在地运行扩散过程：通过左不变随机微分方程注入噪声，在切空间中预测得分，利用指数映射将样本回缩到流形上。

Result: 在CALVIN ABC→D基准上，平均任务长度从3.27提升至3.51（+7.3%）；真实机器人实验表明在多数任务上优于基线方法。

Conclusion: LDA通过直接在SE(3)流形上建模扩散过程，从理论上消除了流形漂移，保证了坐标框架等变性和测地线最优性，显著提升了机器人操作策略的几何一致性和任务性能。

Abstract: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action policies achieve remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet commit a fundamental geometric error we term the $\textbf{Euclidean Fallacy}$: representing SE(3) poses as flat $\mathbb{R}^{12}$ vectors. This approximation induces (1) manifold drift violating SO(3) constraints, (2) broken equivariance under coordinate transformations, and (3) non-geodesic trajectories with excessive kinematic cost. We introduce $\textbf{Lie Diffuser Actor (LDA)}$, a diffusion framework operating intrinsically on SE(3). Our method injects noise through left-invariant SDEs, predicts scores in the tangent space, and retracts samples via the exponential map. This formulation eliminates manifold drift by construction while guaranteeing coordinate-frame equivariance and geodesic optimality. On CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, LDA improves average task length from $3.27$ to $3.51$ ($+7.3\%$). We further validate our method on real robot and the results show that our methodology outperforms the baseline on majority tasks.

</details>


### [381] [PHASOR: Phase-Anchored Universal Action Representations for Humanoid Embodiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01851)
*Kihyun Kim,Chaeyun Kim,Jongho Shin,Taeyoun Kwon,Junghyun Kim,Mijin Koo,Haon Park*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种将动作嵌入空间本身作为一等设计目标的方法，通过周期分解（FFT相位流形+姿态分支）和运动语义蒸馏，构建跨本体的统一运动流形，实现可解释、跨机器人迁移的嵌入空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作嵌入方法将潜在变量视为任务特定的中间产物，导致嵌入空间无结构、依赖具体本体、与运动语义弱关联，限制了可解释性、可控性和跨机器人迁移能力。

Method: 利用运动的内在周期性，将其分解为相位流形（通过FFT参数化系数捕获循环结构）和姿态分支（对非周期配置细节进行条件建模）；结合运动语义蒸馏，得到跨本体的运动流形；将多个人形机器人锚定到共享的预训练人类流形上，形成统一动作嵌入空间。

Result: 在跨本体的动作检索和下游机器人任务上均取得一致的性能提升，验证了该方法在可解释性、本体无关性和迁移能力上的优势。

Conclusion: 动作嵌入空间应作为一等设计目标，其质量直接决定下游策略性能；周期分解+语义蒸馏可构建跨本体、可解释的统一运动表征。

Abstract: Learning a good action embedding space is fundamental to scalable robot policy learning, yet existing methods treat action latents as task-specific intermediates rather than first-class representations. The resulting latents are unstructured, embodiment-specific, and weakly tied to motion semantics, limiting interpretability, controllability, and transferability across robots. We position the action embedding space itself as a first-class design target, with downstream policy quality emerging from representation quality. Exploiting motion's intrinsic periodicity, we factorize it into a phase manifold that captures cyclic structure via FFT-parametric coefficients, together with a pose branch that conditions the manifold on non-periodic configuration detail. Combined with motion-semantic distillation, this factorized structure yields a cross-embodiment motion manifold that is interpretable and embodiment-agnostic by design. Anchoring multiple humanoid robots to a shared human-pretrained manifold then produces a unified action embedding space across diverse platforms, achieving strong cross-embodiment retrieval and consistent gains on downstream robot tasks.

</details>


### [382] [Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy: Learning Action-Chunking Diffusion through Corrections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01865)
*Zhaoting Li,Gang Chen,Javier Alonso-Mora,Cosimo Della Santina,Jens Kober*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy (SDP)，通过对比正负动作块来训练扩散策略，利用人类纠正数据中的负信号提升机器人操作性能，减少对专家数据的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散策略在行为克隆中存在分布偏移问题，需要人类干预纠错，但现有方法忽略了纠正过程中产生的负信号（错误动作），导致过拟合于教师动作且过度依赖专家数据。

Method: 从人类纠正中提取配对的正负动作块，构建期望动作块集合，设计对比训练流程使扩散策略与集合对齐，利用负信号进行学习。

Result: 在多个机器人操作任务上，SDP持续提升策略性能，尤其在对抗噪声数据方面表现出强鲁棒性，并能生成高质量聚合数据集。

Conclusion: SDP有效利用了人类纠正中的负信号，提高了策略学习效率和可靠性，减少了对昂贵专家数据的依赖。

Abstract: Diffusion policies have recently emerged as a powerful framework for robotic manipulation. However, like other behavior cloning methods, they remain vulnerable to distributional shift, often requiring human-in-the-loop interventions to correct failures during deployment. These interactions naturally provide paired supervision in the form of the robot's undesired actions and the human teacher's corrective actions. Yet existing data aggregation pipelines and standard behavior cloning losses largely ignore this negative signal from undesired actions, leading to overfitting to teacher's actions and an increasing reliance on costly expert data. To address this limitation, we propose Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy (SDP), a novel learning framework that utilizes contrastive action-chunk data to train diffusion policies from human corrections. From paired positive and negative action-chunks, SDP constructs a set of desired action-chunks and designs a training pipeline that encourages the diffusion policy to align with the set. Through extensive experiments across multiple robotic manipulation tasks, we demonstrate that SDP consistently improves policy performance, with particularly strong gains in robustness to noisy data. Moreover, SDP induces high-quality aggregated datasets, enabling more efficient and reliable policy learning from human-in-the-loop corrections. Our code is available at https://set-supervised-diffusion-policy.github.io/.

</details>


### [383] [Closed-Form Pose Estimation of Endoluminal Medical Devices via Gradiometer-Based Electromagnetic Localization System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01946)
*Zhiwei Wu,Jiahao Luo,Yubo Pu,Siyi Wei,Yuankai Chen,Jinhui Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于梯度计的电磁定位系统(GELS)，通过紧凑型磁力计阵列作为准梯度计，利用欧拉齐次关系和多源Procrustes配准算法，实现无预校准、无初始猜测的六自由度闭环姿态追踪，实验验证了其快速更新率和亚级偶极子定位能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的六自由度姿态恢复方法通常需要预校准的工作空间场图或迭代非线性优化，限制了嵌入式磁追踪在腔内医疗器械远程导航中的实用性，因此需要一种无需预校准和初始猜测的闭环追踪框架。

Method: 利用紧凑型磁力计阵列作为嵌入式准梯度计，估计局部磁场和梯度张量；通过欧拉齐次关系将场量映射为源与阵列之间的位移；利用至少三个非共线源进行多源Procrustes配准恢复阵列的朝向和位置。

Result: 在多种传感器阵列配置和激励模式下，序列平均位置误差为10.80–15.57毫米，最快更新率达14.49赫兹，中位数求解器运行时间为172微秒。

Conclusion: GELS实现了无需预校准场图和初始猜测的快速闭环姿态追踪，并可作为移动磁参考框架支持亚级偶极子定位；误差分析表明传感器间不一致性和偶极子模型失配是主要精度限制因素，为后续传感器阵列和磁源设计提供了方向。

Abstract: Embedded magnetic tracking holds highly attractive prospects for remote navigation of endoluminal medical devices. However, existing six-degree-of-freedom pose recovery approaches often require pre-calibrated workspace field maps or iterative nonlinear optimization. This letter presents a Gradiometer-Based Electromagnetic Localization System (GELS), a closed-form tracking framework that uses a compact magnetometer array as an embedded quasi-gradiometer to estimate local magnetic fields and gradient tensors. These quantities are mapped by the Euler homogeneous relation to displacements between source and array, from which multi-source Procrustes registration recovers the array orientation and position using at least three non-collinear sources. The algorithm requires known source positions and array geometry, but no pre-calibrated workspace field maps, initial pose guesses, or calibrated excitation-source moments. The recovered pose also enables a proof-of-concept sub-level dipole localization task by serving as a mobile magnetic reference frame. Benchtop experiments across sensor-array configurations and excitation modes demonstrate sequence-averaged position errors of \SI{10.80}{\milli\meter}--\SI{15.57}{\milli\meter}, a fastest update rate of \SI{14.49}{\hertz}, and a median solver runtime of \SI{172.00}{\micro\second}. A perturbation-based error propagation analysis further identifies inter-sensor inconsistency and dipole-model mismatch as the dominant accuracy limits, thereby informing future sensor array and magnetic source design for further reducing pose-estimation error.

</details>


### [384] [Learning Action-Conditional and Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting World Models for Rigid Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01950)
*Jens U. Kreber,Lukas Mack,Joerg Stueckler*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出MRO-GWM，一个以物体为中心的高斯世界模型，通过学习刚性物体在3D空间中的动作条件动力学，实现多物体场景的未来运动预测与操控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型难以处理多刚性物体的3D场景动态预测，尤其是在部分观察和遮挡条件下。作者希望通过物体中心的高斯表示，实现对任意形状刚性物体及其相互作用的建模。

Method: 使用物体中心高斯表示场景（支持任意形状和多物体）；设计时空变换器架构，从历史高斯序列和未来动作预测未来刚体运动；物体在规范坐标系内表示，运动描述为刚体变换；多视角重建训练以应对遮挡。

Result: 在合成数据集（典型家居物体、多物体动力学、机器人末端执行器交互）上分析预测性能；在仿真中通过模型预测控制评估非抓取操控效果。

Conclusion: MRO-GWM能有效学习多刚性物体3D场景的动作条件动力学，在预测和操控任务上展现出潜力。

Abstract: World models enable intelligent agents to predict the consequences of their actions on the environment. In this paper, we propose Multi Rigid Object Gaussian World Model (MRO-GWM), a novel model that learns action-conditional dynamics of rigid objects in 3D. By representing the scene by object-centric Gaussians, we can represent arbitrary object shapes and multi-object scenes. We develop a novel spatio-temporal transformer architecture that predicts future rigid body motion from a history of object Gaussians and future actions. Objects are represented by their Gaussians in a canonical frame, which allows for describing object motion as rigid body transformation. Our model is trained on reconstructions from multiple viewpoints, which requires the model to handle partial observations of objects due to occlusions. We analyze prediction performance of our approach on synthetic datasets composed of typical household objects with multi-object dynamics and interactions by a robot end effector. We also evaluate our model in model-predictive control for non-prehensile manipulation in simulation.

</details>


### [385] [Co-training with Ego-centric Video and Demonstration for Robot Navigation Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01951)
*Shoya Kuno,Yumo Ouchi,Kanata Suzuki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出将第一人称行走视频转化为移动机器人模仿学习数据集的方法，通过估计相机运动并转换为机器人兼容的动作表示，联合训练VLA模型提升导航性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型依赖大规模高质量训练数据，但真实机器人数据采集成本高、耗时长；现有利用人类视频的方法因视角变化难以直接应用于移动机器人导航。

Method: 从人类第一人称行走视频中估计相机运动，将其转换为地面移动机器人可执行的动作表示；然后与机器人真实采集数据联合训练VLA模型。

Result: 在水果搜索导航任务上，联合训练后的模型在语言理解和动作生成鲁棒性上均优于仅使用单一数据源的模型。

Conclusion: 人类第一人称视频可作为移动机器人学习的有效且可扩展的数据源，缓解真实数据采集困难的问题。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are promising for diverse robotic tasks, but their performance heavily depends on large-scale high-quality training data, whose collection on real robots is costly and time-consuming. While prior work has explored augmenting manipulation datasets with egocentric human videos, applying such approaches to mobile robot navigation remains challenging due to viewpoint changes during locomotion. In this paper, we propose a framework that converts egocentric walking videos into datasets for mobile robot imitation learning. The proposed method estimates camera motion from human videos and transforms it into action representations compatible with ground mobile robots. By jointly training a VLA model on human-derived and robot-collected datasets, the model achieves improved language understanding and more robust action generation than training with either data source alone. Experiments on a fruit-search navigation task demonstrate that human egocentric videos provide an effective and scalable data source for mobile robot learning.

</details>


### [386] [WALL-WM: Carving World Action Modeling at the Event Joints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01955)
*Shalfun Li,Victor Yao,Charles Yang,Truth Qu,Regis Cheng,Ryan Yu,Howard Lu,Newton Von,Vincent Chen,Yohann Tang,Maeve Zhang,Ellie Ma,Gody Li,Sage Yang,Lorien Shu,J. W. Gao,Ethan Chen,Colin Ye,Yu Sun,Elise Mon,PS Zhang,Neo Li,Lily Li,James Wang,Ping Yang,Chris Pan,Lucy Liang,Hang Su,Roy Gan,Hao Wang,Qian Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: WALL-WM提出了一种以语义事件为基本学习单元的世界动作模型（WAM），通过事件驱动的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）预训练，解决了传统固定长度动作块带来的粒度不匹配问题，在真实世界泛化评估中取得了SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有WAM通常从多模态或视频基础模型初始化，优化固定长度的动作块，但语言描述语义目标、视觉呈现连续场景动态、动作运行在控制级别的时序尺度，三者之间存在根本性的粒度不匹配，导致VLA训练退化为短视的相关性拟合。

Method: 提出事件驱动的VLA预训练方法，以语义连贯的动作事件作为原子学习单元；构建事件级字幕和聚类平衡采样数据生态系统；支持两种推理模式：事件模式（接受下一事件描述，支持变长执行块）和统一模式（使用VLM配合阶梯解码，条件化常规固定长度块推理）。结合Muon优化器的大规模预训练基础设施。

Result: WALL-WM在语言、场景和任务上展现出广泛的泛化能力，在大规模真实世界泛化评估中取得了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 事件驱动的VLA预训练范式能有效解决粒度不匹配问题，为通用型WAM提供了实用的规模化扩展方案。

Abstract: WALL-WM is a World Action Model that shifts video-action learning from chunk-centric optimization to event-grounded Vision-Language-Action pretraining, using semantically coherent action events as the atomic unit of learning. Existing WAMs commonly initialize from multimodal or video foundation models and then optimize fixed-length action chunks conditioned directly on the current observation and instruction. Although convenient, this chunk-centric formulation creates a fundamental granularity mismatch. Language describes semantic goals and events, vision evolves through continuous scene dynamics, and actions operate at control-level timescales; forcing all three into the same fixed-length prediction window turns VLA training into short-horizon correlation fitting. WALL-WM addresses this mismatch by organizing both supervision and data around semantic events. Specifically, it pairs event-grounded VLA pretraining with a data ecosystem built from event-level captions and cluster-balanced sampling, enabling scalable learning over diverse behaviors, scenes, and task structures. From the same event-pretrained backbone, WALL-WM supports two complementary inference modes. The event mode consumes next-event descriptions and enables variable-length execution chunks, while the unified mode uses a VLM with Staircase Decoding to condition conventional fixed-length chunk inference while preserving a gradient-continuous VLA path. Together with Muon-optimizer-based large-scale pretraining infrastructure, WALL-WM provides a practical scale-up recipe for general-purpose WAMs. Experiments show that WALL-WM generalizes broadly across language, scenes, and tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance in large-scale real-world generalization evaluation.

</details>


### [387] [Market-Based Replanning for Safety-Critical UAV Swarms in Search and Rescue Missions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01970)
*Luiz Giacomossi,Andrea Haglund,Claire Namatovu,Emily Zainali,Esaias Målqvist,Yonatan M. Beyene,Ivan Tomasic,Baran Çürüklü,Håkan Forsberg*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于搜索与救援任务中无人机集群的智能重规划框架（IRDS），采用反向拍卖市场机制和几何共识协议，在25% agent故障率下仍保持93%的任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在搜救任务中，无人机集群面临agent退化（故障）问题，需要容错的分布式协调机制来维持任务持续运行。

Method: 提出IRDS架构，核心包括：(1) 反向拍卖市场机制——agents基于距离加权成本函数竞标搜索区域；(2) 几何共识协议——用于目标验证。通过物理仿真（8个agent，8x8网格）注入随机故障进行测试。

Result: 集群能够在低延迟下自主将故障agent的任务重新分配给其他agent；在25% workforce退化条件下，任务成功率达93%。

Conclusion: IRDS提供了一种鲁棒的、经过实证检验的自愈式空中机器人协调方法，适用于资源受限环境下的集群操作。

Abstract: Reliable autonomous UAV swarms in Search and Rescue (SAR) missions require fault-tolerant coordination capable of sustaining operations despite agent degradation. This paper introduces the Intelligent Replanning Drone Swarm (IRDS), a distributed coordination architecture designed for resource-constrained environments. The proposed framework employs a Reverse-Auction market mechanism where agents bid to service search sectors based on a distance-weighted cost function, coupled with a geometric consensus protocol for target verification. We evaluate the approach through physics-based simulations (N=8 agents, 8x8 grid) subjected to stochastic fault injection. Results indicate that the swarm autonomously reallocates tasks from failed agents with low latency relative to the total mission duration, maintaining a mission success rate of 93% under 25% workforce degradation. The proposed framework demonstrates a robust, empirically tested method for self-healing aerial robotic coordination.

</details>


### [388] [World-Task Factorization for Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02027)
*Eduardo Sebastián,Adrian Pfisterer,Vito Mengers,Oliver Brock,Amanda Prorok*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出将"世界"与"任务"分离作为机器人学习中最根本的因子分解，通过贝叶斯模型证据形式化其不对称性，并利用AICON可微分图结构（组合式、无需任务数据、传播梯度）结合紧凑学习策略实现，在异构机器人、环境、任务逻辑和多模态感知上优于端到端基线和解析启发式方法，支持零样本泛化并可直接迁移到真实硬件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人学习策略在泛化到新约束、队友和环境的组合时面临挑战，而因子分解的方式（从数据涌现到手工设计层次结构/技能库）缺乏对最根本因子的系统性研究。本文认为分离"世界"与"任务"是最基础的因子分解，需探究其成立的条件与原则。

Method: 提出世界/任务因子分解框架：世界因子（体现系统与环境的属性，独立于意图）通过AICON可微分图（递归估计器与互连的组合结构，无需任务数据，传播成本梯度到执行器）建模；任务因子（任务逻辑关于世界允许内容定义）通过紧凑学习策略调制梯度路径。梯度作为两因子间的接口，世界结构通过图传递，任务结构通过成本传递。

Result: 在包含异构机器人、环境、任务逻辑和感知模态的三个问题上，该方法在所有设置中优于端到端基线和解析启发式方法，零样本泛化到分布外配置，且无需重新训练即可迁移到真实硬件。

Conclusion: 世界/任务因子分解通过贝叶斯模型证据的形式化（对齐数据生成过程、通过分析世界模型保持高似然、降低任务参数的奥卡姆剃刀惩罚）是一种有原则的方法，能实现低维学习同时保持结构泛化能力，为机器人学习的因子分解设计提供了新范式。

Abstract: Robot learning must produce policies that generalize to new combinations of constraints, teammates, and environments. To achieve this, we must structurally factor the policy, which is a choice that dictates what generalizes, what requires retraining, and what remains entangled. Existing methods span a wide spectrum, from expecting structure to emerge from data scaling, to hand-designing it via hierarchies, skill libraries or learned specializations. In this paper, we study what we argue is the most fundamental factorization in robotics: separating the world from the task. We investigate the conditions under which this factorization is principled. World factors are properties of the embodied system and the environment; they exist independently of intent. Task factors are defined by the task's logic over what the world admits. We formalize this asymmetry through Bayesian model evidence: it aligns with the data-generating process, maintains high likelihood through an analytical world model, and reduces the Occam razor's penalty on task parameters. We instantiate this factorization by pairing AICON, a differentiable graph of recursive estimators and interconnections that is compositional, operates without task-specific data, and propagates cost gradients to actuators, with a compact, learned policy that modulates gradient paths. Gradients serve as the interface between the two factors: they carry world structure through the graph and task structure through costs, enabling low-dimensional learning while preserving structural generalization. We test the world/task factorization across three problems that encompass heterogeneous robots, environments, task logic and sensorimotor modalities. Our framework outperforms end-to-end baselines and analytical heuristics in all settings, generalizes zero-shot to out-of-distribution configurations, and transfers to real hardware without retraining.

</details>


### [389] [Network Distributed Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Consensus Control of Quadcopters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02107)
*Youssef Mahran,Zeyad Gamal,Aamir Ahmad,Ayman El-Badawy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种网络分布式多智能体强化学习（ND-MARL）框架，用于四旋翼无人机的一致性控制。该框架将群体通信图纳入决策过程，采用2-邻居通信拓扑，每个智能体仅观测两个邻居的信息并通过分布式策略输出动作。高层使用MASAC训练分布式共识规划器，低层由四旋翼控制器跟踪。实验表明，相比集中式MARL，该方法实现了平滑的共识轨迹，且具有零样本可扩展性——三智能体系统训练的策略可直接部署至250个智能体，无需微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多智能体强化学习（MARL）在四旋翼一致性控制中依赖于集中式规划或完全去中心化执行，忽略了群体通信结构对决策的影响，导致可扩展性差、通信开销大。

Method: 提出ND-MARL框架：采用2-邻居通信拓扑，每个智能体仅与两个邻居交换信息；高层使用MASAC训练分布式共识规划器，生成参考目标位置；低层由四旋翼底层控制器跟踪轨迹。

Result: 相比集中式MARL控制器，ND-MARL实现了更平滑的共识轨迹和更好的规划器-跟踪器集成。关键发现：三智能体训练的模型零样本扩展到250智能体（提升约83倍），随着规模增大，由于稀疏信息传播，稳态散布增大但收敛一致。

Conclusion: ND-MARL是一种稳定的、通信感知的分布式四旋翼一致性控制框架，具有良好的零样本可扩展性，适用于大规模无人机集群。

Abstract: This paper proposes a Network Distributed Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (ND-MARL) framework for quadcopter consensus control. Compared to conventional multi-agent MARL formulations that rely on centralized planning or fully decentralized execution, ND-MARL incorporates the swarm communication graph into the decision process. Under a 2-Neighbor communication topology, each agent observes information of only two neighbors and outputs an action through a distributed policy. A high-level distributed consensus planner is trained using Multi-Agent Soft Actor-Critic (MASAC) and embedded in a hierarchical stack to generate reference target positions tracked by a low-level quadcopter controller. Results demonstrate smooth consensus trajectories and planner-tracker integration when compared to a centralized MARL controller. Most notably, the learned controller exhibits zero-shot scalability, as policies trained on a three-agent system are deployed to swarms of up to 250 agents under the same 2-Neighbor communication topology without retraining or fine-tuning, achieving consistent convergence with increasing steady-state spread at large team sizes due to sparse information propagation. These findings highlight ND-MARL as a stable framework for distributed, communication-aware quadcopter consensus control.

</details>


### [390] [FW-NKF: Frequency-Weighted Neural Kalman Filters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02251)
*Adnan Harun Dogan,Berken Utku Demirel,Christian Holz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出频率加权神经卡尔曼滤波器（FW-NKF），通过引入因果频谱成形算子到卡尔曼测量残差中，并联合学习观测网络和状态转移网络，有效抑制频带噪声，在混沌系统和惯性位姿估计等基准上实现定位误差降低10%及方位精度显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典卡尔曼滤波器在处理频率相关扰动（如传感器振动、电磁干扰、周期性噪声）和模型失配时表现不佳；现有深度卡尔曼滤波器变体虽能学习潜在状态转移，但缺乏显式机制抑制实际场景中常见的带限噪声成分。

Method: 1) 在卡尔曼测量残差中嵌入因果频谱成形算子（频率加权）；2) 联合学习观测网络与状态转移网络（深度潜在状态建模）；3) 同时自适应调整滤波器频谱和潜在状态表示，衰减噪声主导频带并捕获复杂残差结构。

Result: 在四个异质基准（包括多维洛伦兹混沌系统和全身惯性位姿估计）上，定位误差降低最高10%，方位精度显著提升；消融实验证实频率加权和深度潜在状态建模均对整体性能有贡献。

Conclusion: FW-NKF通过统一混合架构将频谱感知机制融入卡尔曼滤波，有效抑制频带噪声并提升鲁棒性，为机器人状态估计提供了一种优于传统方法和DKF变体的新方案。

Abstract: Robust state estimation is central to robotic autonomy, yet classical Kalman filters struggle with frequency-dependent disturbances and model mismatch such as sensor vibrations, electromagnetic interference, and periodic noise. Although Deep Kalman Filter (DKF) variants extend the Extended Kalman Filtering (EKF) framework by learning latent transitions, they lack explicit mechanisms to suppress band-limited noise components that typically corrupt sensor measurements in real-world scenarios. We introduce the Frequency-Weighted Neural Kalman Filter (FW-NKF), a unified hybrid approach that embeds a causal spectral-shaping operator into the Kalman measurement residual and jointly learns observation, and transition networks. By adapting both the filter spectrum and the latent state representation, FW-NKF attenuates the noise-dominated frequency bands while capturing complex residual structures. We conduct extensive experiments on four heterogeneous benchmarks, including chaotic systems such as multi-dimensional Lorenz systems and full-body inertial pose estimation, and find a reduction in localization error of up to 10% as well as marked improvements in orientation accuracy. Our ablation studies confirm that frequency weighting and deep latent-state modeling contribute to overall performance.

</details>


### [391] [Dexterity-BEV: Aligning 3D World and Actions for Generalizable Robot Policies Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02274)
*Huayi Zhou,Wei Gao,Dekun Lu,Ruiji Liu,Zhanqi Zhang,Ziyang Zhang,Jian Chen,Wenlve Zhou,Sheng Xu,Shumin Li,Kangyi Guo,Shichen Xu,Zixin Huang,Yongyi Su,Kui Jia*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Dex-BEV框架，通过将2D视觉输入提升为3D对齐的顶点图谱与顶点谱表示，并引入鸟瞰图（BEV）对齐机制，解决端到端操作策略中存在的3D空间缺失与输入输出空间错位问题，提升机器人操作的泛化性与一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于VLM的端到端机器人操作策略受限于2D RGB输入，忽略了操作任务固有的3D本质；同时存在输入输出空间以及不同机器人本体、相机设置、轨迹数据集之间的3D空间对齐缺失问题。

Method: 1) 提出对齐顶点图谱（aligned vertex map）与顶点谱（vertex spectrum）——一种像素级3D表示，通过相机标定与可选深度将2D输入提升至3D；2) 通过将逐像素3D信息与机器人动作对齐到共享坐标系，统一输入输出空间；3) 设计规范BEV对齐框架并构建BEV图像，获得对相机姿态变化鲁棒的视角不变表示；4) 开发数据处理流程与新颖的时间对齐方案，实现跨机器人、人类操作员和数据集的轨迹对齐。

Result: 缓解了输入输出的时空错位问题，提升了真实世界机器人操作的一致性与泛化能力。

Conclusion: Dex-BEV通过3D空间对齐与BEV视角不变表示，有效弥补了2D VLM在3D操作任务中的结构性缺陷，为通用灵巧操作提供了一条可行路径。

Abstract: End-to-end manipulation policies, combined with web-scale pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs), show the promise for generalizable and dexterous robotic manipulation. However, they inherit two key limitations from 2D foundation models: 1) the reliance on 2D RGB inputs that ignores the intrinsically 3D nature of manipulation; and 2) the lack of spatial 3D alignment between input-output spaces as well as across diverse robot embodiments, camera setups, and trajectory datasets. In this paper, we present a series of contributions to address these issues. First, we introduce aligned vertex map and vertex spectrum -- a pixel-wise 3D representation that elevates 2D visual inputs to 3D, using camera calibration and optional depth. This novel input representation marries 3D awareness with the generalization of 2D large VLMs. Then, we propose to align the inputs and outputs of manipulation policies by expressing per-pixel 3D information of each camera view and robot actions to a shared coordinate. Based on this, we designate a canonical Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) alignment frame and innovatively propose to construct BEV images, producing a view-invariant representation robust to camera pose variations. To enable training and evaluation at scale, we develop a comprehensive data processing pipeline to perform such alignments; we also introduce a novel temporal alignment scheme for trajectories across diverse robots, human operators, and datasets. These contributions collectively mitigate input and output spatial-temporal misalignments, improving the consistency and generalization for real-world manipulation. Pretrained checkpoint, source code and data processing pipeline are available in https://hnuzhy.github.io/projects/Dex-BEV.

</details>


### [392] [RoboSemanticBench: Diagnosing Semantic Grounding in Action Prediction for VLA Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02277)
*Bin Yu,Yao Zhang,Haishan Liu,Shijie Lian,Yuliang Wei,Xiaopeng Lin,Zhaolong Shen,Changti Wu,Ruina Hu,Bailing Wang,Cong Huang,Kai Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出RoboSemanticBench (RSB)基准，用于诊断VLA模型在动作预测中的语义理解能力。实验发现许多VLA模型虽然能完成抓取动作，但语义上选择正确目标的表现接近随机水平，揭示了语义能力与动作预测之间的系统性差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型评估存在捷径（视觉或指令-动作关联），难以诊断模型是否真正利用语义理解来指导动作预测。作者希望设计一个需要真正语义理解才能完成任务的基准，量化语义能力与动作预测之间的差距。

Method: 构建RSB基准，机器人面对多项选择题（数学/常识），需从候选答案块中抓取正确语义对应的块。覆盖控制算术、小学数学理解、常识/事实理解，包含四选一和十选一两种难度。评估多个代表性VLA模型，控制抓取成功率后统计语义正确选择率。

Result: VLA模型能够学习抓取候选块，但在语义正确选择上的表现接近甚至低于随机水平。表明存在语义能力与动作预测之间的持久性差距（semantic grounding gap）。

Conclusion: VLA模型虽能拟合动作分布，但未能真正将预训练后端的语义理解迁移到动作预测中，亟需加强语义推理与动作执行的桥梁。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are built on the premise that semantic understanding from pretrained language or vision-language backbones should guide robot action prediction. Yet robot fine-tuning is optimized as imitation over task-specific action distributions, and many evaluations can be solved through visual or instruction-action shortcuts. We introduce RoboSemanticBench (RSB), an embodied benchmark for diagnosing semantic grounding in action prediction: whether post-trained VLA models can use complex instruction semantics to select and manipulate the correct physical target. In each episode, a robot receives a multiple-choice math or general-knowledge question, observes candidate answer blocks, and must grasp the block corresponding to the correct answer. RSB covers controlled arithmetic, grade-school mathematical understanding, and commonsense or factual understanding under four-choice and ten-choice suites. Across representative VLA models, we find that many policies learn to grasp candidate blocks but select the semantically correct block at near-random or below-random rates after controlling for grasp success, revealing a persistent gap between backbone-level semantic competence and action prediction.

</details>


### [393] [Dynamics Are Learned, Not Told: Semi-Supervised Discovery of Latent Dynamics Geometries For Zero-Shot Policy Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02280)
*Zhiming Xu,Weitao Zhou,Xianghui Pan,Nanshan Deng,Chengju Liu,Qijun Chen,Chenpeng Yao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种从结果导向视角进行动力学自适应的方法，通过对比学习约束轨迹编码器的Lipschitz常数，使策略能够学习动力学如何影响交互结果，而非直接识别动力学参数。在MuJoCo基准测试中，该方法在严重动力学变化（包括未建模和时变参数）下持续优于参数中心方法，并提升了分布内稳定性和潜在空间可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有依赖显式编码物理参数的动力学自适应方法在未建模或复合动力学变化下表现脆弱，亟需一种更鲁棒的自适应范式。

Method: 方法从结果导向视角出发，通过对比学习上界约束轨迹动力学编码器的Lipschitz常数，构建平滑且任务相关的潜在拓扑结构，使策略学习动力学对交互结果的影响而非具体参数值。

Result: 在MuJoCo基准上，该方法在严重动力学变化（包括未建模和时变参数）下持续优于参数中心基线，同时提升分布内稳定性和潜在空间可解释性。

Conclusion: 控制潜在几何结构是实现鲁棒动力学自适应的一个有效原则性机制。

Abstract: Real-world dynamics shifts pose a critical challenge for reinforcement learning in robotics, as policies tightly coupled to nominal environments often fail catastrophically when physical conditions change. Most existing methods rely on encoding explicitly identified physical parameters into a latent context, a parameter-centric paradigm that depends on pre-specified axes of variation and becomes brittle under unmodeled or compound dynamics changes. We revisit dynamics adaptation from an outcome-centric perspective: rather than telling policies what the dynamics are, we enable them to learn how dynamics affect interaction outcomes. Theoretically, this is grounded in a monotonic relationship between target-domain regret and the Lipschitz constant of a trajectory dynamics encoder. Practically, this constant can be upper-bounded through contrastive learning, yielding a smooth, task-relevant latent topology without privileged dynamics information. On MuJoCo benchmarks, our method consistently outperforms parameter-centric baselines under severe dynamics shifts, including unmodeled and time-varying parameters, while also improving in-distribution stability and latent interpretability. Overall, these results validate that controlling latent geometry is a principled mechanism for robust adaptation.

</details>


### [394] [A Kinetic Theory of Encounter-Based Information Propagation in Multi-Robot Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02296)
*Alkesh K. Srivastava,Philip Dames*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于遭遇的信息传播动力学理论，用于分析多机器人系统在无持久网络连接下的目标跟踪问题，识别了访问限制、陈旧限制和几何限制三种极限，并通过大规模仿真验证了该理论框架的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人系统无法假设持久的网络连接，而目标跟踪性能依赖于信息感知、传输和使用的时效性。当机器人仅通过物理遭遇交换信息时，跟踪成为一个动力学信息传输问题，亟需理解这种信息传播机制及其对跟踪性能的影响。

Method: 提出了一种基于遭遇的信息传播动力学理论，分析了信息传播的三种极限（访问、陈旧、几何），并通过大规模仿真（变化团队规模、操作区域、通信距离和目标速度）来评估理论。

Result: 仿真结果支持访问-陈旧-几何分解：通信覆盖范围决定了访问转变；信息可获取后，跟踪误差由目标位移决定；该响应在受限区域呈局部线性，但在更广范围内因感知刷新和有界几何呈非线性。

Conclusion: 建立了一个动力学理论框架，用于预测和设计基于遭遇的多机器人系统，表明访问坐标和陈旧坐标能够可靠地描述跟踪性能。

Abstract: Multi-robot systems cannot assume persistent network connectivity. We study this problem through target tracking, where performance depends on how quickly target information is sensed, transported through the team, and used before it becomes stale. When robots exchange information only through physical encounters, tracking becomes a kinetic information-transport problem: robot motion induces encounters, encounters carry target-state estimates, information age determines staleness, and stale information produces tracking error. This paper develops a kinetic theory of encounter-based information propagation and identifies three limits. The first is an access limit -- information cannot support team-level coordination unless it spreads beyond the robots that sensed it. The second is a staleness limit -- even propagated information loses value as the target moves. The third is a geometry limit -- when target motion outpaces information transport, tracking error approaches a saturation regime where communication improvements alone have diminishing returns. We evaluate the theory through large-scale simulations varying team size, operating area, communication range, and target speed. Results support the proposed access-staleness-geometry decomposition: communication coverage governs the access transition; once information is accessible, tracking error is shaped by target displacement; and this response is locally linear in restricted regimes but nonlinear over broader ranges because of sensing refreshes and bounded geometry. Across controlled sweeps and joint variation, the derived access and staleness coordinates reliably describe tracking performance. Together, these results establish a kinetic-theoretic framework for predicting and designing encounter-based multi-robot systems.

</details>


### [395] [FATE-VLA:Failue-aware test generation for vision-language-action models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02307)
*Arusa Kanwal,Pablo Valle,Shaukat Ali,Aitor Arrieta*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种主动寻找失败的测试生成方法，用于评估VLA模型，通过多样性探索和代理模型引导测试走向高风险区域，在四个SOTA模型上发现更多失败（成功率从64.4%降至34.7%），呼吁从静态基准测试转向主动寻找失败的评估范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的VLA模型评估依赖静态基准测试，随机采样任务场景，但高维具身空间中失败是稀疏且聚集的，静态测试低估了鲁棒性风险。

Method: 将VLA评估重构为主动失败发现问题，提出结合多样性驱动的探索与从观察执行中学到的代理模型的失败感知测试生成方法，引导测试走向高风险且多样化的场景区域。

Result: 在四个SOTA VLA模型上，该方法相比基线发现多达29.7%的额外失败，并揭示更多样化的失败模式。例如GR00T-N1.6模型成功率从64.4%降至34.7%。

Conclusion: VLA评估应从被动测量固定任务套件转向自适应、主动寻找失败的测试生成，在部署前暴露模型弱点的结构。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly used as generalist robot policies, yet their evaluation still relies largely on static benchmarks that randomly sample task scenes. In high-dimensional embodied spaces, failures are sparse and clustered, so static benchmarking can underestimate robustness risks. We reframe VLA evaluation as an active failure-discovery problem and propose a failure-aware test-generation approach that combines diversity-driven exploration with surrogate models learned from observed executions. The method steers testing toward high-risk yet diverse scene regions. Across four state-of-the-art VLA models, it uncovers substantially more failures (up to +29.7 % over selected baselines) while revealing more diverse failure modes. This mean that, for instance, in the case of GR00T-N1.6, success rate dropped from 64.4% to 34.7%. More broadly, our findings call for a shift in VLA evaluation: from passive measurement on fixed task suites to adaptive, failure-seeking test generation that exposes the structure of model weaknesses before deployment.

</details>


### [396] [Towards Precise Intent-Aligned VLA Aerial Navigation via Expert-Guided GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02313)
*Tianyang Chen,Wenjun Li,Xin zhou,Yuze Wu,Fei Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出EG-GRPO框架，通过将少量专家数据融入在线强化学习，并设计异构流水线加速仿真，使VLA无人机导航在复杂指令任务中的成功率提升至SFT基线的2.13倍，意图对齐性能提升60.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准SFT方法在无人机VLA导航中面临数据稀缺、泛化有限和对复杂人类意图监督不足的问题，而现有强化微调方法在连续大空间中探索效率低下。

Method: 提出EG-GRPO（专家引导的组相对策略优化），在在线rollout中融入少量专家数据以提升探索效率；同时设计异构流水线，实现并行仿真与推理，将rollout时间缩短43.5%。

Result: 在多个复杂人类意图指定的任务中，EG-GRPO将成功率达到SFT基线的2.13倍，意图对齐性能提升60.9%。

Conclusion: 该框架能够推动无人机导航向精确的意图对齐飞行方向发展。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising end-to-end paradigm for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to accomplish complex tasks specified by fine-grained instructions. However, standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) suffers from data scarcity, limited generalization, and weak supervision for nuanced and complicated human intents. Reinforcement fine-tuning offers a natural way to mitigate these challenges and align policy behaviors with human intents through designable feedback, but applying it to aerial navigation remains challenging due to inefficient exploration in expansive continuous spaces. To address these challenges, we introduce an efficient reinforcement learning (RL) framework for VLA-based aerial navigation. At its core, we propose EG-GRPO (Expert-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization) to augment online rollouts with few-shot expert data. Additionally, we design a heterogeneous pipeline enabling parallel simulation and inference, which reduces rollout time by 43.5%. Across multiple tasks specified by complex human intents, EG-GRPO improves the success rate to 2.13x that of the SFT baseline, while improving intent alignment performance by 60.9%. These results demonstrate that our framework can move aerial navigation toward precise intent-aligned flight.

</details>


### [397] [A Simulation Platform for Flapping-Wing Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02370)
*Haichuan Li,Tomi Westerlund*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了FWAV-Sim，一个基于Unity的高保真扑翼飞行器仿真框架，整合了复合气动模型、分形噪声湍流生成和真实传感器模拟，旨在缩小仿真与现实的差距，提升扑翼飞行器自主系统的开发能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仿真平台因采用过度简化的层流假设和理想化传感器模型，无法捕捉真实世界中复杂的湍流模式和感知限制，导致仿真与现实存在显著差距，严重阻碍了扑翼飞行器鲁棒自主系统的发展。

Method: FWAV-Sim包含三个核心组件：(1) 结合准稳态叶素理论与钝体阻力效应的复合气动模型；(2) 通过分形噪声合成生成时空相关的湍流；(3) 包含噪声IMU、LiDAR点云和RGB相机图像的真实传感器模拟。平台可规模化生成包含状态、力、湍流场和多模态传感器流的同步数据集。

Result: 实验验证表明，在FWAV-Sim中开发的自主管线（包括控制器和感知系统）展现出显著提升的仿真能力，推进了扑翼飞行系统的仿真开发性能。

Conclusion: FWAV-Sim通过高保真仿真有效缩小了仿真与现实的差距，为扑翼飞行器自主系统的开发提供了更可靠的平台，有望推动该领域取得突破性进展。

Abstract: Flapping-wing aerial vehicles (FWAVs) demonstrate remarkable agility but face substantial autonomy challenges due to their high sensitivity to aerodynamic disturbances and limited sensor payload capacity. Current simulation platforms typically rely on oversimplified laminar flow assumptions and idealized sensor models, failing to capture the complex turbulence patterns and perceptual limitations encountered in real-world operation. This simulation-to-reality discrepancy significantly impedes the development of robust autonomy systems for FWAVs. We introduce FWAV-Sim, a high-fidelity Unity-based simulation framework that integrates: (1) a composite aerodynamic model combining quasi-steady blade-element theory with bluff-body drag effects, (2) spatiotemporally correlated turbulence generation through fractal noise synthesis, and (3) realistic sensor simulation including noisy IMU measurements, LiDAR point clouds, and RGB camera feeds. Our platform enables scalable generation of synchronized datasets containing ground-truth vehicle states, aerodynamic forces, turbulent wind fields, and multi-modal sensor streams. Experimental validation demonstrates that autonomy pipelines (including both controllers and perception systems) developed in FWAV-Sim exhibit significantly improved simulation capability, thereby advancing the outstanding performance in simulation-based development for flapping-wing aerial systems.

</details>


### [398] [NDPP-Grasp: Non-Differentiable Physical Plausibility Constraint-Guided Task-Oriented Dexterous Grasp Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02432)
*Qiuchi Xiang,Haoxuan Qu,Hossein Rahmani,Jun Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对任务导向的灵巧抓取生成中物理合理性与任务对齐解耦的问题，提出将物理合理性约束直接注入扩散模型去噪过程的新框架，在保持任务对齐的同时全程指导抓取生成，实验验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散方法将任务对齐和物理合理性解耦处理，先训练任务对齐的抓取扩散模型，再通过后处理修正物理合理性。这种事后修正策略仅在生成完成后施加物理指导，生成轨迹本身不受物理约束，导致次优抓取。

Method: 提出一种新框架，将物理合理性指导直接注入任务对齐的抓取扩散模型的去噪过程中，即使在物理约束不可微的情况下也能有效实施，使物理合理性在整个去噪阶段塑造抓取生成，同时保持任务对齐。

Result: 大量实验证明了该框架的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过将物理合理性约束提前到去噪过程而非事后修正，能够在不牺牲任务对齐的前提下获得更优的灵巧抓取姿态。

Abstract: Task-oriented dexterous grasp generation aims to produce dexterous grasp poses that are both physically plausible and functionally suitable for specified manipulation tasks. Existing diffusion-based methods often address these two requirements in a decoupled manner: they first train a grasp diffusion model for task alignment and then rely on post-generation refinement to improve physical plausibility. However, this after-the-fact correction strategy applies physical plausibility guidance only once the grasp has already been generated, leaving the generation trajectory itself unguided by physical constraints and potentially leading to suboptimal grasps. To address this problem, we propose a novel framework that directly injects physical plausibility guidance into the denoising process of a task-aligned grasp diffusion model in a practical and effective manner, even when physical plausibility constraints are non-differentiable. This allows physical plausibility to shape grasp generation throughout denoising while preserving task alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of our framework.

</details>


### [399] [Intercepting the Future: Latent-Space Predictive World Model for Dynamic VLA Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02486)
*Shahram Najam Syed,Arthur Jakobsson,Haoran Hao,Jeffrey Ichnowski*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: AHEAD是一个轻量级预测-然后-动作模块，通过运动感知的潜在世界模型为冻结的VLA模型赋予动态场景自适应能力，在静态操作泛化基础上实现高速运动物体的可靠抓取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型假设场景在观测与执行之间是静止的，导致物体以非平凡速度运动时，延迟超过可抓取的时间窗口，在动态操控任务中失败。

Method: 提出AHEAD框架：1) 训练一个小型世界模型，在VLA特征空间中预测未来patch token，以光流计算的逐token速度和加速度为条件；2) 语言-运动显著性掩码聚焦于任务相关区域；3) 自适应预测步长，在不确定性超过阈值时停止；4) 将预测的未来token送入冻结的动作解码器替代当前token。

Result: 仅增加4.9M参数到7B OpenVLA上，20个动态仿真场景中成功率达79-97%（基线31-58%）；物理xArm 7上传送带/滚球任务29-30/30，球拍拦截23/30，抛射体抓取19/30（基线均为0/30）。

Conclusion: AHEAD以极小参数量扩展，有效桥接了VLA模型的静态假设与真实动态世界的鸿沟，在高速动态操控任务上实现了从零到有、从低到高的显著性能提升。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generalize across static manipulation but fail when objects move during task execution. They map the current observation to an action and assume the scene is stationary between observation and execution, so at any non-trivial object speed the resulting latency exceeds the time available to grasp. We close this gap with AHEAD (Anticipatory Horizon Extrapolation with Adaptive Dynamics), a predict-then-act wrapper that augments a frozen VLA with a motion-aware latent world model. A small world model trained on manipulation video forecasts future patch tokens in the VLA's feature space, conditioned on per-token velocity and acceleration from optical flow. A language-and-motion saliency mask concentrates prediction on task-relevant patches, and the model rolls forward for an adaptive horizon, halting when prediction uncertainty crosses a threshold. The frozen action decoder then receives the predicted future tokens in place of the current ones. AHEAD adds 4.9M parameters to a frozen 7B OpenVLA and reaches 79 to 97% success across 20 dynamic simulation scenarios where the strongest baseline reaches 31 to 58%. On a physical UFactory xArm 7, AHEAD succeeds on 29/30 to 30/30 on three conveyor and rolling-ball tasks, 23/30 on paddle interception, and 19/30 on projectile catching where every baseline scores 0/30.

</details>


### [400] [IMAC-AgriVLN: Can Agricultural Vision-and-Language Navigation Agents be Aware of Instruction Mistakes?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02519)
*Xiaobei Zhao,Xingqi Lyu,Xin Chen,Xiang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出A2A-MI基准（在农业VLN指令中插入三类错误）和IMAC模块（分析指令与当前图像，判断并纠正指令错误），解决了现有农业VLN方法假设指令正确而脱离现实的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有农业VLN方法假设指令完全正确，与实际场景中指令可能包含错误的情况不符，导致机器人缺乏怀疑和纠正指令的意识。

Method: 1) A2A-MI基准：半自动数据标注器在原始指令中插入三类错误（多样化高效生成）；2) IMAC模块：分析指令与当前正面图像，判断指令是否有误并在必要时尝试纠正。

Result: SOTA农业VLN智能体在A2A-MI上SR下降57%、NE上升9%；集成IMAC后性能显著提升，缩小了与无错误指令场景的差距。

Conclusion: 农业VLN智能体需要具备指令错误意识，IMAC模块有效弥补了这一缺陷，使机器人更符合现实应用需求。

Abstract: Agricultural robots are serving as powerful assistants across a wide range of agricultural tasks, nevertheless, still heavily relying on manual operations or railway systems for movement. The AgriVLN method and the A2A benchmark pioneeringly extended Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) to the agricultural domain, enabling a robot to navigate to a target position following a natural language instruction. However, almost all the prior methods adopt an ideal assumption that the given instructions themselves are correct, which does not align with the realistic scenarios, because anybody may say an instruction with mistakes. To bridge this gap, we propose the A2A-MI benchmark, in which we build a semi-automatic data annotator to insert three mistake classifications into each original instruction in a more diversified and efficient way. We test several state-of-the-art agricultural VLN agents on it and observe a sufficient drop with -57% on SR and -9% on NE, from which we suggest that an agricultural VLN agent tends to assume that the given instruction is correct, so does not have the awareness to doubt it when the scenes it sees do not align with the instruction it receives. To build the awareness on instruction mistake, we propose the IMAC module analyzing the instruction and the current front-facing image, to judge whether the instruction has mistakes and attempt to correct it when needed. We integrate IMAC into the baseline model, and observe a noteworthy improvement, sufficiently narrowing the gap to the performance on instructions without mistakes. Project: https://github.com/AlexTraveling/IMAC-AgriVLN.

</details>


### [401] [AFUN: Towards an Affordance Foundation Model for Functionality Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02551)
*Zhaoning Wang,Yi Zhong,Jiawei Fu,Henrik I. Christensen,Jun Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个名为我们的模型的具身基础模型，从单张RGB-D图像和语言任务描述中预测任务条件功能掩码（交互位置）和3D接触后运动曲线（交互方式），在8个测试集上显著超越基线，并可直接部署于真实机器人操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法要么只能定位任务相关区域而不指定可执行动作，要么能预测动作但扩展性有限，缺乏一个既能理解交互位置又能理解交互方式、且能在开放世界泛化的具身基础模型。

Method: 构建大规模标准化数据管道，将异构的机器人、人类、仿真和真实扫描数据转换为统一的具身模式（含语言、掩码和以物体为中心的3D运动标签）；模型从单张RGB-D图像和语言描述中预测任务条件功能掩码和3D接触后运动曲线。

Result: 在4个基准的8个测试集上，分割任务平均gIoU/cIoU提升+23.9/+26.3；接触点预测命中率提升12.7-61.3%；3D运动预测在三个测试集上均达到最佳性能。

Conclusion: 该模型无需微调或任务特定启发式即可部署于真实机器人操作，在开放世界具身任务中展现出良好的泛化能力，是迈向具身基础模型的重要一步。

Abstract: Affordance understanding bridges visual perception and physical action, serving as an explainable interface for robot manipulation in open and unstructured real-world environments. Yet, building an affordance foundation model that not only understands where and how the interaction should happen, but also generalizes across diverse environments, objects, and tasks, remains a long-standing research challenge. Existing methods typically address only part of this challenge, either localizing task-relevant regions without specifying executable motion, or predicting motion but with limited scalability. In this paper, we present ourmodel, a step towards an affordance foundation model for functionality understanding. From a single RGB-D observation and a language task description, ourmodel predicts a task-conditional functional mask (where to interact) and a 3D post-contact motion curve (how to interact). To support open-world generalization, we build a large-scale standardized data pipeline that converts heterogeneous robot, human, simulation, and real-world scan data into a shared affordance schema with language, masks, and object-centric 3D motion labels. We evaluate ourmodel from three aspects: for affordance segmentation, ourmodel outperforms all baselines by a large margin across 8 test sets from 4 benchmarks, improving mean gIoU/cIoU by +23.9/+26.3; for contact-point prediction, it predicts substantially more accurate points, with a 12.7--61.3% hit-rate gain over the best baseline; and for 3D motion, it achieves the best performance on all three test sets. ourmodel can be deployed for real-world robot manipulation without finetuning for robot embodiment or using task-specific heuristics, demonstrating the ability to adapt to open-world affordance tasks. Project page: https://www.zhaoningwang.com/AFUN

</details>


### [402] [Permissive Safety Through Trusted Inference: Verifiable Belief-Space Neural Safety Filters for Assured Interactive Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02562)
*Haimin Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于共形预测的算法，用于认证信念空间安全过滤器（BeliefSF）在高概率下的安全性，通过关注推理可靠区域来降低保守性，并在人机交互仿真中验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全过滤器通常仅在物理空间操作，忽略了机器人在线学习和适应的能力。BeliefSF虽能通过运行时推理主动降低不确定性，但由于推理错误和神经网络近似，难以提供正式的安全保证。

Method: 利用共形预测对BeliefSF进行高概率安全认证，通过关注推理预期可靠的区域来利用信念空间安全过滤的结构，保持标准共形预测的简单性和样本复杂度，同时认证更少保守的安全过滤器。

Result: 在人-车交互仿真基准测试中，所提方法相比标准共形预测基线，能够认证一个显著更宽容（更少保守）的信念空间安全过滤器。

Conclusion: 该方法在保证安全性的同时，有效降低了BeliefSF的保守性，为人机交互中机器人的安全决策提供了一种可验证的框架。

Abstract: Autonomous robots that interact with people must make safe and efficient decisions under human-induced uncertainty, such as their preferences, goals, competency, and willingness to cooperate. Safety filters are a popular approach for ensuring safety in interactive robotics, since their modular design separates safety from performance, allowing robots to operate safely around people with minimal impact on task efficiency. While traditional safety filters typically operate only in the physical space, neglecting the robot's ability to learn and adapt online, the recently proposed belief-space safety filter (BeliefSF) reasons about robot safety in closed-loop with runtime inference that actively reduces the robot's uncertainty online, thereby reducing conservativeness in filtering. However, providing formal safety guarantees for robots deploying BeliefSF remains a significant challenge due to errors in runtime inference and neural approximation of safety filters required to handle the high dimensionality of belief spaces. In this paper, we propose an algorithmic approach to certify high-probability safety of BeliefSF using conformal prediction, while explicitly accounting for the reliability of the robot's runtime inference module. Our method leverages the structure of belief-space safety filtering by focusing verification on a region where inference is expected to be reliable. It preserves the simplicity and sample complexity of standard conformal prediction, yet can certify a substantially less conservative safety filter. Through a simulated human-vehicle interaction benchmark, we show that our approach verifies a significantly more permissive belief-space safety filter than a standard conformal prediction baseline.

</details>


### [403] [RoboDream: Compositional World Models for Scalable Robot Data Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02577)
*Junjie Ye,Rong Xue,Basile Van Hoorick,Runhao Li,Harshitha Rajaprakash,Pavel Tokmakov,Muhammad Zubair Irshad,Vitor Guizilini,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种以具身为中心的世界模型，通过合成逼真的演示数据来扩展机器人学习，支持轨迹复用和无道具遥操作，显著降低真实数据需求并提升策略性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实遥操作收集大规模多样化演示数据成本高昂且耗时，现有视频扩散模型仅做表面视觉增强或产生物理不可行的动作（具身幻觉），亟需可扩展的合成数据生成方法。

Method: 提出以具身为中心的世界模型，将生成过程锚定在渲染的机器人运动上，并显式条件化场景和物体先验，从而解耦轨迹执行与环境合成；具体实现两个能力：①检索与重生（将已有轨迹适配到全新场景），②无道具遥操作（操作员凭空操控，模型事后合成目标物体与场景）。

Result: 真实实验表明，生成的数据能够持续提升下游策略性能，显著减少多种操作任务中的真实数据需求。

Conclusion: 该工作为机器人学习提供了一种可扩展的合成数据范式，在降低数据收集成本的同时保证了物理可行性，具备良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Scaling robot learning requires large-scale, diverse demonstrations, yet real-world data collection via teleoperation remains prohibitively expensive and time-consuming. While video diffusion models offer a promising avenue for data scaling, existing generative approaches are often limited to superficial visual augmentation, or suffer from embodiment hallucinations that yield physically infeasible motions. We present a generalizable embodiment-centric world model that achieves scalable data generation by synthesizing photorealistic demonstrations with novel objects, in novel scenes, and from novel viewpoints. Our approach anchors generation to rendered robot motion while conditioning on explicit scene and object priors, effectively decoupling trajectory execution from environment synthesis. This formulation has the potential to unlock two powerful data scaling capabilities: (1) retrieval and rebirth, which repurposes existing trajectories into entirely new contexts without new motion data; and (2) prop-free teleoperation, where operators manipulate empty air and the model hallucinates the target objects and scene afterwards, eliminating reset time. We demonstrate with real-world experiments that our generated data consistently improves downstream policy performance and significantly reduces real-world data requirements across diverse manipulation tasks.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [404] [Position Paper: Post-Solve Robustness in Decision Engines: Feasible Regions and Smoothness Under Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00002)
*Yi-Xiang Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出现有MILP决策引擎的输出在部署后常因参数扰动而失效，提出应在求解后增加一个"鲁棒性审计层"，形式化定义了参数空间上的ε-近优可行邻域和决策空间上的解平滑性，并综合敏感性分析、鲁棒优化、邻域搜索、对抗测试等方向，呼吁将鲁棒性作为决策引擎的一级输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MILP求解器输出名义最优解，但实际部署中成本、需求、资源等参数的小扰动会导致解不可行或产生跳跃性方案变化，这种"求解后鲁棒性差距"未被现有优化流程所覆盖，也缺乏对学习辅助决策系统的评估维度。

Method: 提出一个后求解鲁棒性层(post-solve robustness layer)，核心包含两个形式化对象：(i) ε-近优可行邻域——参数空间中确保可行且近优的扰动范围；(ii) 决策空间中的解平滑性——少量组合编辑后替代方案的竞争力。综合了敏感性分析、稳定分析、鲁棒优化、邻域搜索、对抗测试和学习增强等现有工具的部分答案。

Result: 提出了一个统一的研究议程，包括：围绕当前解的可认证内逼近、带校准不确定性的概率鲁棒性估计、对抗鲁棒性边界、与求解器验证对齐的学习预测与解释，以及一套紧凑的报告模板和评估协议。

Conclusion: 呼吁将鲁棒性作为决策引擎的一级输出，使后求解鲁棒性分析成为优化管线中一个不可或缺的标准层。

Abstract: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) decision engines routinely output nominally optimal plans for high-stakes industrial systems. Yet deployment rarely matches solve-time assumptions: small perturbations in costs, demands, or resource availability can invalidate feasibility or trigger discontinuous shifts to qualitatively different solutions. We argue that this post-solve robustness gap is a missing layer in today's optimization pipelines and a missing evaluation dimension for learning-enabled decision systems. Rather than replacing robust optimization or stochastic programming, the proposed layer audits a solved incumbent and returns solver-backed evidence about how far that solution can be trusted. We formalize two central objects: (i) an $ε$-near-optimal feasible neighborhood in parameter space, capturing when an incumbent remains feasible and near-optimal under perturbations, and (ii) solution smoothness in decision space, capturing whether nearby alternatives with small combinatorial edits remain competitive. We then synthesize the most relevant partial answers from sensitivity and stability analysis, robust optimization, neighborhood search, adversarial testing, and learning-based enhancements, and articulate an agenda for a unified post-solve robustness layer. Concretely, we call for certified inner approximations around the incumbent, probabilistic robustness estimation with calibrated uncertainty, adversarial robustness margins, and learning-based prediction and explanation aligned with solver-backed verification. We conclude with a compact reporting template and evaluation protocol that would make robustness a first-class output of decision engines.

</details>


### [405] [Emergent Collaborative Deliberation in Multi-Model AI Systems: A BFT-Derived Protocol for Epistemic Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00005)
*VD Doske*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Consilium协议是一种基于拜占庭容错的AI deliberation架构，通过认知人格分离模型能力与推理方式，在1,478轮会话中证明：廉价模型可媲美前沿模型、RLHF对齐导致特定领域认知盲点、协议自身无方向性偏差，且OOS证据检索能发现训练数据无法覆盖的盲点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI辩论/审议系统将模型间分歧视为错误或噪声，未能有效利用分歧作为认知信号；同时，模型的对齐训练（如RLHF）可能导致系统性偏见，但缺乏结构化框架来检测和量化这些偏见。

Method: 提出Consilium Protocol：基于拜占庭容错架构，为语言模型分配工程化的认知人格（cognitive persona），分离模型基础能力与推理模式；引入In-Sample/Out-of-Sample验证框架（借鉴量化金融），区分训练数据共识与经验可验证结论。

Result: (1) 认知人格而非底层模型决定认知行为，廉价模型（0.0002美元/批）与前沿模型（10.69美元）产出相当；(2) RLHF对齐造成领域特定盲点：争议政策话题的对抗性挑战比科学话题低12.3个百分点，AI安全话题呈现非对称偏见（Δ=11.6%）；(3) 协议自身无方向性偏差（移民Δ=2.3%，可再生能源Δ=1.2%）；(4) OOS证据检索100%验证239项主张，发现167项训练数据不可见的盲点。

Conclusion: Consilium Protocol提供了一种低成本、可复现的结构化多模型审议框架，能有效揭示和量化模型的对齐偏见，且自身保持中立。总成本仅217美元，已开源以支持独立验证。

Abstract: We present the Consilium Protocol, a Byzantine Fault Tolerance-derived architecture for structured multi-model AI deliberation that treats inter-model disagreement as epistemic signal rather than error. The protocol assigns engineered cognitive personas to language models -- separating what a model is from how it reasons -- and introduces an In-Sample/Out-of-Sample validation framework adapted from quantitative finance to distinguish training-data consensus from empirically grounded conclusions. Across 1,478 deliberation sessions spanning 32 topics in 10 domain categories, we demonstrate that (1) the cognitive persona, not the underlying model, determines epistemic behavior: free edge-inference models costing 0.0002 USD per batch produced comparable analytical output to frontier models costing 10.69 USD; (2) RLHF alignment training creates measurable, domain-specific epistemic blind spots -- contested policy topics exhibit 12.3 percentage points less adversarial challenge than settled science topics, and AI safety topics show asymmetric bias ($Δ$=11.6%) where models challenge claims that AI is dangerous far more vigorously than claims that AI risk is overstated; (3) the protocol exhibits no directional bias of its own (immigration $Δ$=2.3%, renewables $Δ$=1.2%); and (4) out-of-sample evidence retrieval validated 239 claims with 100% evidence retrieval and surfaced 167 blind-spot discoveries invisible to training-data deliberation. Run-to-run reproducibility across randomized model$\times$persona assignments averages $\pm$2.2% standard deviation. Total cost for the complete battery including all overhead: 217 USD. We release the protocol specification under MIT license to enable independent verification.

</details>


### [406] [Deliberative Curation: A Protocol for Multi-Agent Knowledge Bases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00007)
*Steven Johnson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出面向AI agent的知识治理协议，通过三层设计（知识生命周期、声誉加权审议、分级制裁）提升系统在对抗环境下的韧性，实验表明其相比多数投票机制退化速度慢约3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI agent正从孤立工具演变为协作参与共享知识生态系统，但人类平台治理机制（威慑制裁、独立假设、共识达成）因agent无状态性、模型同质性和谄媚问题而失效，亟需适应AI特性的知识策展治理方案。

Method: 设计审议策展协议，包含：(1)知识制品生命周期的标记转换系统形式化；(2)结合Beta声誉与EigenTrust放大的声誉加权审议投票；(3)针对无状态agent的分级制裁（区分故障与对抗行为）。通过100个agent、7种行为原型、2种对抗场景的基于agent的模拟进行验证。

Result: 在良态条件下精度略有折损，但对抗环境下显著优于多数投票：中等对抗0.826 vs 0.791 (p<0.001)，高强度对抗0.807 vs 0.740 (p<0.001)，退化速度慢约3倍。消融实验显示承诺-揭示投票隐藏是最关键组件（精度提升8.2-8.6pp，p<0.001）。分级制裁未在模拟中被触发，尚未得到实证验证。

Conclusion: 审议策展协议能有效提升AI agent知识协作系统的对抗韧性，以可控的良态精度代价换取显著更强的鲁棒性。承诺-揭示机制是关键设计要素，但分级制裁的有效性仍需进一步研究验证。

Abstract: As AI agents transition from isolated tools to collaborative participants in shared knowledge ecosystems, governing collective knowledge curation becomes a critical challenge. Human platform governance mechanisms do not transfer directly: agent statelessness undermines deterrence-based sanctions, model homogeneity violates independence assumptions underlying crowd wisdom, and sycophancy collapses deliberative consensus.
  We propose a deliberative curation protocol combining three governance layers: (1) a knowledge artifact lifecycle formalized as a labeled transition system; (2) reputation-weighted deliberative voting integrating Beta Reputation with EigenTrust amplification; and (3) graduated sanctions adapted for stateless agents, including broken agent handling distinguishing malfunction from adversarial behavior.
  We evaluate the protocol through agent-based simulation with 100 agents across seven behavioral archetypes under two adversity scenarios (30 seeds, paired t-tests). The protocol trades modest precision under benign conditions for substantially better resilience under adversity: 0.826 vs 0.791 for majority vote under moderate adversity (p<0.001), widening to 0.807 vs 0.740 under stress (p<0.001). The protocol degrades roughly three times more slowly than majority vote. Ablation analysis identifies commit-reveal vote concealment as the most impactful single component (8.2-8.6pp precision improvement, p<0.001), outperforming reputation weighting and deliberation combined. Graduated sanctions were not exercised in simulation and remain empirically unvalidated.

</details>


### [407] [Agents on a Tree: Pathwise Coordination for Multi-Objective Molecular Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00008)
*Jia Zhang,Tengfei Ma,Tianle Li,Daojian Zeng,Xieping Gao,Xiangxiang Zeng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ATOM，一个多智能体框架，将分子优化建模为树结构搜索，每个节点对应原子操作并配有专门智能体，通过路径协调替代全局共识，实现多目标帕累托覆盖提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子优化方法依赖单一策略或固定标量化，难以表征多样权衡并探索多个有前景的设计轨迹，且早期决策强烈约束下游结果。

Method: 将分子优化形式化为树结构搜索，每个节点对应原子操作并托管一个针对特定目标或决策上下文的智能体；智能体沿树的不同路径协调而非强制全局共识；通过全局记忆平衡探索与利用。

Result: 在涉及活性、可合成性和ADMET相关属性的多目标基准上，ATOM持续优于强基线，在帕累托覆盖和超体积指标上均取得改进。

Conclusion: 路径式多智能体协调策略能有效处理分子设计中的长程依赖，为多目标分子优化提供了一种新范式。

Abstract: Multi-objective molecular optimization requires searching vast chemical spaces under conflicting objectives, where early design decisions strongly constrain downstream outcomes. Existing methods typically rely on a single policy or fixed scalarization, which limits their ability to represent diverse trade-offs and to explore multiple promising design trajectories. We propose ATOM, a multi-agent framework that formulates molecular optimization as a tree-structured search. Each node corresponds to an atomic operation and hosts an agent specialized for a particular objective or decision context. Agents coordinate along different paths of the tree rather than enforcing a global consensus, enabling the method to maintain and compare alternative molecular evolution trajectories. A global memory of past optimization behaviors further supports balanced exploration and exploitation across objectives. This tree-structured interaction enables reasoning over long-horizon dependencies inherent in molecular design. Experiments on challenging multi-objective benchmarks involving activity, synthesizability, and ADMET-related properties show that ATOM consistently achieves improved Pareto coverage and hypervolume over strong baselines. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of pathwise multi-agent coordination for molecular optimization. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ATOM-41CE.

</details>


### [408] [Optimal Transport-based Permutation-Invariant Bayesian Optimization of Offshore Wind Farm Layouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00009)
*Antonio Candelieri,Laurens Bliek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于最优传输理论的排列不变贝叶斯优化方法（PIBO），用于解决布局优化问题中目标函数对决策变量排列不敏感的问题，在海上风电场布局优化中相比标准BO方法效果更好且计算时间减半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准贝叶斯优化无法利用目标问题中可能存在的对称性（如布局优化问题中点的顺序不影响目标函数值），导致优化效率低下。

Method: 基于最优传输（Optimal Transport）理论，提出排列不变贝叶斯优化（PIBO）方法，使算法能够识别并利用布局问题中的置换不变性。

Result: 在海上风电场布局优化实际工业应用中，PIBO相比标准BO方法获得更优的布局方案，同时计算时间减少约一半。

Conclusion: 通过引入最优传输理论实现排列不变性，能够显著提升贝叶斯优化在布局类问题上的性能与效率。

Abstract: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely and successfully adopted for solving optimization problems having an expensive-to-evaluate, black-box, and non-convex objective function. However, the vanilla BO algorithm is not able to exploit possible symmetries characterizing the target problem. An intuitive case is given by optimal location problems, whose decision variables refer to a finite set of points within a continuous space, with the order of points not affecting the value of the objective function. We refer to this setting as optimization over layouts to distinguish from optimization over point-clouds where, instead, the order of points counts. As an instance of optimization over layouts we consider a real-life industrial-relevant application, that is the optimization of the layout of an offshore wind farm: given identical wind turbines, switching any pair of them has not any effect on the annual energy production. Based on Optimal Transport theory, we propose a Permutation-Invariant BO approach, namely PIBO, proved to provide better wind farm layouts when compared to the vanilla BO approach while cutting computation time roughly in half.

</details>


### [409] [MindGames Arena Generalization Track: In2AI Solution with Delayed Per-Step Reward Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00017)
*Aliaksei Korshuk,Alexander Buyantuev,Ilya Makarov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向多智能体战略交互场景的延迟逐步奖励归因方法（结合资格门控），通过回合后计算奖励、按语义回传至关键步骤并过滤无效步，配合vLLM异步生成、课程对手采样和多层分批次构建，实现了高效稳定的强化学习训练；仅8B参数的开源模型在MindGames Arena基准上超越了GPT-5等大型闭源系统，夺得双赛道冠军。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多智能体战略交互中，标准强化学习假设每步可分配奖励，但由于动作结果依赖于未来未发生事件、违规动作及其他玩家决策，导致奖励分配失效。本文旨在解决这一奖励时间与智能体间纠缠问题。

Method: 提出延迟逐步奖励归因与资格门控，在回合结束时计算奖励，按任务语义回传至发起步骤，排除缺乏有效依赖信息的步骤；结合vLLM连续批处理实现异步rollout生成、基于课程的对手采样及多层分层的批次构建。

Result: 在NeurIPS 2025 MindGames Arena基准上，仅8B参数的开源模型匹配或超越了GPT-5等更大规模商业系统，在Open和Efficient双赛道均获第一名。

Conclusion: 该方法使小规模开源模型在多智能体战略交互中达到甚至超越大型闭源系统的性能，验证了延迟奖励归因与异步训练框架的有效性。

Abstract: Training language model agents for multi-agent strategic interaction presents a core difficulty: the quality of any action may depend on future events that never materialize, on moves that violate game rules, or on decisions made by other players. Standard reinforcement learning assumes that rewards can be assigned at each step, but this assumption fails in settings where outcomes are entangled across time and agents. We introduce delayed per-step reward attribution with eligibility gating, an episode lifecycle and postprocessing pipeline that computes rewards only at episode end, propagates them back to originating steps according to task-specific semantics, and excludes steps that lack valid dependent information from training. Together with asynchronous rollout generation via vLLM's continuous batching, curriculum-based opponent sampling, and multi-level stratified batch construction, this approach enables stable, sample-efficient RL training in multi-agent environments. We evaluate on the MindGames Arena benchmark at NeurIPS 2025, where a single 8-billion-parameter open-source model trained with our method matched or surpassed substantially larger proprietary systems, including GPT-5, in head-to-head play and took first place in both the Open (unrestricted) and Efficient (<=8B parameters) tracks.

</details>


### [410] [Universal Quantum Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00045)
*Sungyong Chung,Alireza Talebpour*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出通用量子变压器（UQT），一种基于多量子比特系统物理特性的量子原生计算架构，通过参数化几何相位嵌入和SU(2)波干涉实现精确数学与代数推理。在5量子比特基板上，UQT完美学习循环模算术（Z₁₁）和非阿贝尔代数（S₄置换群），实现数学精确的确定性泛化，称为"结晶化"现象，超越经典网络的随机不稳定性和grokking现象。该架构从理论上避免了经典自注意力的二次方瓶颈，并通过对数压缩表示维度消除过度参数化，并在IBM量子计算机上验证了可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典连续空间神经网络在锁定精确数学对称性（如模算术和非交换代数）时存在根本性困难，需要大量参数缩放才能近似离散逻辑规则，即使出现grokking延迟泛化现象仍存在随机不稳定性。作者旨在利用量子系统的物理特性作为通用归纳偏置，从根本上解决这一问题。

Method: 提出UQT架构，完全依赖参数化几何相位嵌入和SU(2)波干涉，而非翻译经典神经机制。量子注意力电路在高度紧凑的5量子比特基板上运行，利用多量子比特系统的物理属性作为通用归纳偏置。

Result: UQT完美学习两种截然不同的形式类别：循环模算术（Z₁₁）和非阿贝尔代数（S₄置换群）。经典注意力网络在收敛时表现出随机不稳定性，而UQT实现数学精确的确定性泛化（结晶化）。该架构理论上绕过经典自注意力的二次方瓶颈，对表示维度进行对数压缩，消除过度参数化，并在NISQ硬件上验证了可行性。

Conclusion: 参数化量子拓扑被确立为精确人工智能的通用优越物理基板。这项工作展示了量子原生架构在精确数学推理方面的根本优势，为克服经典神经网络在对称性学习上的根本局限提供了新范式。

Abstract: Classical continuous-space neural networks fundamentally struggle to lock into exact mathematical symmetries, such as modular arithmetic and non-commutative algebra. To approximate these discrete logical rules, they often rely on massive parameter scaling, resulting in stochastic instability even after delayed generalization phenomena known as grokking. Here, we introduce the Universal Quantum Transformer (UQT), a fundamentally novel, quantum-native computing architecture that uses the physical properties of multi-qubit systems as a universal inductive bias for exact mathematical and algebraic reasoning. Rather than translating classical neural mechanisms, our framework relies entirely on parameterized geometric phase embedding and $SU(2)$ wave-interference. We demonstrate that the quantum attention circuit, operating on a highly compact 5-qubit substrate, perfectly learns two highly distinct formal classes: cyclic modular arithmetic ($\mathbb{Z}_{11}$) and non-Abelian algebra (the $S_4$ permutation group). While classical attention-based networks exhibit stochastic instability at convergence, the UQT achieves mathematically exact, deterministic generalization. We refer to this phenomenon as crystallization: a step beyond the well-known phenomenon of grokking. Crucially, this framework yields massive computational and memory advantages by theoretically bypassing the quadratic bottleneck of classical self-attention, and by logarithmically compressing the required representation dimension to eliminate the massive over-parameterization inherent to classical networks. Finally, we deploy this architecture on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware, proving its viability on current IBM Quantum computers. These results establish parameterized quantum topology as a universally superior physical substrate for exact artificial intelligence.

</details>


### [411] [Grokers: Bottom-Up Inductive Comprehension and Write-Time Intelligence over Typed Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00050)
*Gregory Magarshak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Grokers提出了一种通过自底向上归纳遍历依赖子图来构建类型化知识图谱持久结构化理解的架构。它通过在写入时（而非查询时）付出智能计算成本，使后续查询实现零LM成本，并证明了三个形式化定理及一种确定性语义搜索替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RAG方法在每次查询时都需重新计算理解成本，效率低下。作者希望构建一种架构，将理解成本前置到写入阶段，使后续查询无需再调用语言模型。

Method: 1) 设计自主Groker代理，在类型化流图中自底向上遍历节点，通过受控LM调用提取结构化属性，并归纳组合理解结果；2) 维护事务性反规范化索引确保上下文块字节一致，实现KV缓存高命中率；3) 提出智慧库增长协议；4) 提出基于同义词缓存的确定性语义搜索替代方案。

Result: 证明了三个定理：字节同一性定理（上下文块在语义变化间字节一致，KV缓存命中率接近100%）、积累单调性定理（无需LM的交互比例随已完成交互数非递减）、双向遍历序定理（自顶向下生成与自底向上理解是DAG上各自任务的唯一正确遍历序）。同义词缓存的LM回退率在有限词汇域趋近于零。

Conclusion: Grokers通过在写入时承担计算成本，实现了查询时的零LM开销，为知识图谱的持久化理解提供了一种高效、确定性的新范式。

Abstract: We present Grokers, an architecture for building persistent, structured comprehension of typed knowledge graphs through bottom-up inductive traversal of dependency subgraphs. Unlike retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which pays full comprehension cost at every query, Grokers pushes intelligence to write time: autonomous Groker agents analyze nodes in a typed stream graph, extract structured attributes via governed language model (LM) calls, and inductively compose that understanding upward through dependency relations, writing enriched typed attributes that serve all future queries at zero additional LM cost. We prove three formal properties: (1) the Byte-Identity Theorem, establishing that context blocks assembled from a transactionally-maintained denormalization index are byte-identical across LM turns between semantic changes, enabling KV-cache hit rates approaching 100%; (2) the Accumulation Monotonicity Theorem, establishing that the fraction of interactions resolved without LM calls is non-decreasing in the number of completed interactions under a governed wisdom library growth protocol; and (3) the Dual-Traversal Ordering Theorem, establishing that top-down generation and bottom-up comprehension are the unique correct traversal orderings for their respective tasks over a dependency DAG, and that their composition closes into a complete generation-comprehension cycle. We further present a deterministic alternative to embedding-based semantic search, with a synonym caching protocol whose LM fallback rate converges to zero for finite-vocabulary domains. A reference implementation is provided in the open-source Qbix / Safebox / Safebots stack.

</details>


### [412] [Product-Aware Deep Autoencoders for Robust Process Monitoring in Multi-Product Cyber-Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00052)
*MD Shafikul Islam,Jordan Carden*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出工业4.0环境下，基于全局数据训练的通用异常检测模型在多产品等级柔性制造中存在"盲点"漏洞，容易遗漏针对特定产品模式的隐蔽异常或攻击。作者提出一种产品感知自编码器（Product-Aware Autoencoder），通过限制学习域至产品等级特定的分布来缓解此风险。在扩展TE过程基准上的实验表明，该方法在标准检测指标上与全局模型相当，但在压力测试中对假想攻击场景的检测准确率达到100%，而全局模型仅22.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前工业异常检测普遍采用"产品无关"的全局模型，但柔性制造中多产品等级的运作模式使得全局模型为适应多种模式而扩大决策边界，形成"盲点"，导致针对特定产品模式的隐蔽异常或网络物理攻击无法被有效检测。作者旨在揭示这一安全漏洞并提出缓解方案。

Method: 提出Product-Aware Autoencoder方法，将异常检测模型按产品等级进行分解，使每个自编码器仅学习对应产品等级的正常数据分布，从而避免全局模型因多模式混合导致的决策边界膨胀问题。

Result: 在扩展的Tennessee Eastman Process基准上，产品感知框架与全局基线在标准检测指标上表现相当；但在模拟攻击场景的压力测试中，产品感知系统实现100%检测准确率，而全局模型仅在22.2%的场景中成功检测到偏差。

Conclusion: 在柔性制造环境中，通用的全局异常检测器存在不容忽视的安全风险，应转向面向制造模式的诊断架构以提高检测鲁棒性。

Abstract: As Industry 4.0 accelerates the integration of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) in manufacturing, robust anomaly detection has become critical for ensuring process safety and security. Current data-driven approaches typically employ "product-agnostic" or global models trained on the aggregate of all normal operating data. However, modern industrial facilities frequently operate under diverse product grades. While computationally simple, these global models inherently expand their decision boundaries to accommodate the variance of multiple modes, creating a "blind spot" where subtle anomalies or targeted cyber-physical attacks may be masked by the wide acceptance region of the model. In this work, we first demonstrate that the vulnerability described above is present in global-agnostic models operating across multiple product grades. We then present a Product-Aware Autoencoder as a principled mitigation that restricts the learning domain to grade-specific distributions. While this approach reduces the identified blind-spot risk, we do not claim it as the optimal mitigation among all possible alternatives. We rigorously validate this approach against a Global Agnostic baseline using the Extended Tennessee Eastman Process (TEP) benchmark. Our empirical results indicate that the Product-Aware framework performs comparably to the global baseline on standard detection metrics, while offering improved robustness to product-grade-specific operating modes. Most critically, stress tests simulating our hypothetical attack scenarios reveal that while the global model fails to detect operational deviations in 77.8% of the scenarios, the product-aware system achieves 100% detection accuracy. These findings suggest that, in flexible manufacturing environments, generalized anomaly detectors can pose non-trivial security risks, motivating a shift toward mode-aware diagnostic architectures.

</details>


### [413] [On the evolution of the concept of probability as a mirror of the evolution of reason](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00102)
*Jean-Louis Le Mouël,Vincent Courtillot,Dominique Gibert,Vladimir Kossobokov,Jean-Baptiste Boulé,Pierpaolo Zuddas,Fernando Lopes,Païkan Marccagi,Alexis Maineult*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文追溯了概率论从赌博计算到科学推理框架的演变历程，指出其从数学工具发展为理性本身的转变。文章比较了概率论、模糊逻辑和深度学习三种不确定性处理范式，认为现代科学理性不能仅依赖数据驱动，而需明确表达不确定性、模糊性和推理过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不仅将概率论发展视为数学史，更将其阐释为理性本身的转变过程，并探讨理性如何超越概率的边界。

Method: 通过历史与认识论视角，梳理概率论从帕斯卡/费马到柯尔莫哥洛夫再到贝叶斯推理的发展，并将其与模糊逻辑和深度学习进行对比分析。

Result: 概率论能量化明确定义命题的不确定性，但无法形式化概念本身的模糊性；模糊逻辑处理分级意义和定性判断，深度学习则基于几何插值和优化的预测模式。

Conclusion: 当代科学理性不能简化为数据驱动的性能，需要明确表达不确定性、模糊性和推理过程。

Abstract: Over the centuries, probability theory has grown from the calculus of games of chance into a central framework for reasoning under uncertainty. This article interprets that evolution not merely as a mathematical history, but as a transformation of rationality itself. From Pascal and Fermat's combinatorial symmetry to the inductive logic of Bayes and Laplace, from Poisson's statistics of events to Kolmogorov's axiomatic formalization, probability progressively incorporated uncertainty, time, and coherence into scientific judgment. This trajectory reaches a mature epistemological form in modern Bayesian inference, especially in Tarantola's view of probability as a logic of information, where prior knowledge and data are combined coherently. Yet this framework also exposes a limit: probability quantifies uncertainty about well-defined propositions, but does not by itself formalize the vagueness of the concepts used to describe them. The article therefore examines how rationality extends beyond probability. Fuzzy logic is presented as a rigorous language for graded meaning and qualitative judgment, while deep learning is analyzed as a distinct, powerful mode of prediction based on geometric interpolation and optimization rather than explicit inference. By situating probability, fuzzy logic, and deep learning in a common historical and epistemological perspective, the article clarifies their roles and limits. It argues that contemporary scientific rationality cannot be reduced to data-driven performance alone, but requires the explicit articulation of uncertainty, vagueness, and inference.

</details>


### [414] [Evaluating Interactive Reasoning in Large Language Models: A Hierarchical Benchmark with Executable Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00103)
*Mingyuan Fan,Weiguang Han,Daixin Wang,Cen Chen,Zhiqiang Zhang,Jun Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个多轮交互式推理评估框架，将推理视为主动获取证据和更新信念的过程。LLM需在仅知任务规则的情况下，向隐藏环境发出查询、整合部分观测结果，并自主决定何时提交答案。基于474个可执行游戏构建基准，评估了多个前沿LLM，发现该基准具有高度区分性，且上下文扰动和反事实修正会显著影响模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理评估多聚焦于单轮静态任务，缺乏对模型在动态交互环境中主动获取信息、更新信念、以及面对扰动和反事实情境下适应性能力的系统评测。

Method: 设计多轮交互框架，LLM需基于任务规则向隐藏环境主动查询，逐步整合部分观测，并自主决定终止条件。基准包含474个可执行游戏，每个游戏在5种配置搜索空间（对应5个难度级别）下测试。评估维度包括成功率、交互效率、上下文鲁棒性（受控扰动）和元认知适应（反事实修正与必要性判断）。

Result: 该基准具有高度区分性，能够暴露LLM在成功率和交互效率上的显著差异。上下文扰动导致中等但一致的性能下降，而反事实修正和必要性判断导致的性能下降更为显著。

Conclusion: 多轮交互式推理框架能更全面地评估LLM的推理能力，尤其对元认知适应方面的挑战远超简单扰动，为后续研究提供了新的评测维度。

Abstract: We introduce a multi-turn interactive framework for reasoning evaluation that treats reasoning as active evidence acquisition and belief updating. Wherein, LLMs receive only the task rules, must issue targeted queries to a hidden environment, integrate partial observations over time, and decide when to submit a final answer. Beyond standard success rate and interaction efficiency, we evaluate contextual robustness under controlled contextual perturbations, and metacognitive adaptation through counterfactual revision and necessity judgment. We instantiate the framework as a benchmark of 474 executable games, each evaluated under five fixed configuration search spaces corresponding to five difficulty levels, and evaluate a broad set of frontier LLMs. Results show that the benchmark is highly discriminative, exposing large differences not only in success rate but also in interaction efficiency. Moreover, we empirically show that contextual perturbations cause moderate but consistent declines, whereas counterfactual revision and necessity judgment lead to much larger drops.

</details>


### [415] [A Multi-AI-agent Framework Enabling End-to-end Finite Element Analysis for Solid Mechanics Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00138)
*Titu Ranjan Sarker,Muhammed Jawaad Zulqernine,Ling Yue,Shaowu Pan,Chenxi Wang,Shiyao Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于大语言模型的多智能体框架AbaqusAgent，可将自然语言指令自动转化为有限元分析流程，在50个固体力学问题中达到86%成功率，显著降低了FEA使用门槛。


<details>
